Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Title: eCommerce Growth Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an eCommerce Growth Analyst to join our eCommerce Solutions team to lead data analytics and real-time tracking, ensuring the quality and stability of our rapidly growing white-label solution.




What you will do:

Performance Optimisation & Analytics: lead site performance optimisation through advanced analytics tools and data-driven insights.
Monitoring & Growth Analysis: monitor key metrics such as traffic, user behaviour, and conversion rates to identify growth opportunities and drive continuous improvement.
Analytics Tools & Tracking: leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, and heatmaps to track, measure, and analyse website performance.
A/B Testing & CRO: implement A/B testing and Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) strategies to improve user engagement and conversion performance.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: collaborate closely with marketing, UX, and development teams to enhance user experience and overall site effectiveness.
Tag Management & Data Accuracy: ensure accurate website tracking, including the setup and management of tags in Google Tag Manager for reliable data collection.




Workplace: Germany & Remote // Berlin & Hybrid

We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.




Who you are:

Experience & Background: 4+ years of experience in growth, product optimisation, or similar roles within B2C e-commerce or consumer digital products.
Conversion Optimisation & Experimentation: strong hands-on experience improving website and app conversion funnels through experimentation, user behaviour analysis, and data-driven decision making.
Analytics & Tools: strong hands-on experience with tools such as Amplitude, Google Analytics, SQL, Grafana, Hotjar, and A/B testing platforms like AB Tasty, Maxymizer, or Optimizely.
Ownership & Problem Solving: strong ownership mindset with the ability to proactively investigate root causes and drive solutions when metrics or user behaviour change unexpectedly.
Customer & Product Mindset: customer-focused and curious about user behaviour, with the ability to identify friction points and opportunities to improve conversion and overall experience.
Analytical Thinking: ability to turn complex business problems into clear hypotheses, experiments, and actionable product improvements.
Collaboration & Ways of Working: comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, and commercial teams.
Communication Skills: clear communicator who can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability & Impact: thrives in fast-moving environments, adapts quickly to ambiguity, and is motivated by driving measurable business impact.




What you can expect:

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company




Our hiring process for this role:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Benedetta, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Francesc Ferre.




For any queries, please contact your Talent Partner at (talent@distribusion.com).

Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability, scalability and the most advanced technology? Come join us!

Title: Product Analyst Lead
Description:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.




Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.




You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.




Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!




This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.




YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:

Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next
Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on
Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up
Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it
Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before
Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool
Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions




YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:

You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course
You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself
Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways
You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through
You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data
When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it




Bonus points for:

Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)
A strong statistics background
Dagster or Airflow for scheduling
Data catalogues like DataHub




OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:

Warehouse: Snowflake
Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster
Experimentation: GrowthBook
Self-service analytics: Omni
ML workflows: Prefect
GenAI: Claude




If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.




WHY US?

An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating
A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year
30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you
A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!
A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement
A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks
Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development
A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health




DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.




READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

Your CV in English
Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

Title: (Senior) Product Analyst, Real Estate & Motors (d/f/m) - 1-year fixed-term contract
Description:
Job Description

Kleinanzeigen is the leading online classifieds market in Germany. Users buy and sell on Germany's No. 1 for classifieds mainly second-hand. In this way they make an active contribution to more sustainability. On average, more than 55 million ads are available in numerous categories – from children's supplies to electronics and real estate. Kleinanzeigen also offers small and medium-sized businesses the opportunity to present their services online. Around 35 million users per month make Kleinanzeigen one of the most widely used websites in Germany. Kleinanzeigen was launched in September 2009 as eBay Kleinanzeigen. Since June 2021, the company has been part of Adevinta, a global provider of online classified ads. In May 2023, the name was changed to Kleinanzeigen.

The Job

As a (Senior) Product Analyst in the Real Estate & Motors Analytics team, you are the data expert for product decisions across the RE and Motors domains. You ensure tracking is right, experiments are sound, and stakeholders have the data foundations they need to act independently. Working closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, and Business peers, you combine deep analytical expertise with a builder mindset — automating what can be automated, enabling what can be self-served, and owning the complex cases that need expert judgment.

This is a limited 1-year contract position. The role is hybrid and our office is in Berlin. You report to the Analytics Lead, Real Estate & Motors.

Job requirements

Who You Are


You bring strong SQL skills and hands-on product analytics experience including tracking ownership, experimentation, and performance KPI analysis.
You bring practical experience with AI tools in analytical workflows and know when to automate vs. when to go deep. Agentic AI is your daily companion and you come with a proven track record of utilizing AI tooling to get annoying and valuable tasks done (big plus: Claude).
You have personally defined tracking specs, coordinated their implementation across PM/SWE/DE, and verified them in production — not just configured existing tools.
You've designed and evaluated A/B tests independently, not just read results. You understand statistical power, guardrail metrics, and when not to trust a result.
You demonstrate an ownership mindset, strong prioritization, and clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are comfortable building data products for self-service — semantic layers, metrics definitions, reusable templates.
Nice to have: advanced experimentation methods (CUPED, sequential testing, Bayesian approaches), exposure to Python, dbt, or modern analytics engineering tooling; experience in classifieds or marketplace platforms.


Job responsibilities

What You'll Do


Own product analytics for RE and Motors squads: tracking definition, funnel analysis, KPI monitoring, and performance reporting across seeker experience, seeker monetization, seller experience and Motors product initiatives.
Define event tracking specifications end-to-end — from schema design through coordination with PM, SWE, and DE to verification in production. Build automated checks that scale beyond manual QA.
Lead A/B experimentation: design tests from hypothesis to readout, apply advanced methods (sequential testing, CUPED, interaction effects) where appropriate, and build self-service tooling and templates so product teams can run standard experiments independently.
Contribute to the semantic layer and data model so RE&M data is self-queryable by stakeholders — reducing analyst bottlenecks for routine data access.
Integrate AI tools into your analytical workflows and help stakeholders do the same. Automate where it creates leverage; go deep where it matters.
Support forecasting, planning, and operational analytics initiatives across the RE&M domain.
Own your backlog — prioritize with transparency, push back on low-value requests, and make trade-offs visible to stakeholders.


Job benefits

At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive.

✨ Flexibility


Flexible working time (hybrid)
20 days “work from anywhere”
Paid additional parental leave for both parents
Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move)


❤️‍🩹 Wellbeing & Support


Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones
Annual company sports events
Pension and life insurance


📚 Growth & Development


Personal development budget
Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career


🛍️ Perks & Everyday benefits


Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts
An attractive referral program
Transportation allowance
Free shipping on Kleinanzeigen Direktkauf


Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability.

If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
Description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About The Support Group

As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores.

During the years we’ve invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it’s the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations’ quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.

About The Support Analytics Team

Our Support Analytics team’s main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡

You’ll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.

Our humble expectations

Required:


5+ years of experience in a data science or analytics position
Experience building forecasting models and time series analysis (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)
Experience in Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis
Deep knowledge of statistical packages in Python or R
Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets
Ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders Good to have:
Experience using ML for forecasting
Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform
Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools


What we offer


The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in Berlin. 💙
You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.


Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via zhanna.filintseva@wolt.com

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Title: Senior People Science Analyst (12 month FTC)
Description:
We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together.

Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.

Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.

Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.

For more information visit cultureamp.com.

We're looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team on a 12-month fixed term contract.

You'll specifically partner with customers across EMEA and North America on bespoke research using Culture Amp and customer-supplied data, owning studies from question through to action. GenAI tools will be part of that workflow, helping you work more efficiently, as you continue to identify further areas for improvement.

As a thought leader in HR analytics, you'll combine data across diverse customers and use methods from psychology, economics and business to generate advanced insights into how employee experience shapes outcomes like turnover, sales performance and customer satisfaction. You'll surface trends for the HR community and make complex findings accessible through clear, engaging stories and practical strategies.

The work is technical and customer-facing. You'll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public. You'll also help customers and colleagues build confidence with data.

Because the team is small and the projects are complex, you'll have real ownership over which questions are worth answering and how they get answered.

As part of this team of amazing humans,

You will:


Lead customer discovery and own studies end to end, from clarifying the business problem and shaping the research question through to design, delivery and recommendations

Title: Digital Analyst - Marketing Technology (m/w/d)
Description:
Aufgabenschwerpunkte


Du arbeitest an der Planung und Umsetzung von erfolgreichen Digital Analytics Konzepten für unsere verschiedenen Kunden von SMB bis Enterprise
Dabei wendest du dein spezialisiertes Know-how in den Bereichen Tracking (Google Tag Manager), Datenanalyse (Google Analytics & weitere Tools), Reporting und Automatisierung (Google Data Studio) an und vertiefst dieses stetig
Die Durchführung von Kundenterminen und -korrespondenz ist ein wichtiger Teil deiner Aufgaben
Du ermittelst und analysierst relevante KPIs, erstellst automatisierte Reports und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden ab
Du evaluierst und implementierst neue MarTech- und Google Cloud Tools im Rahmen der strategischen Kundenarbeit
Du unterstützt in der Beratung unserer Fachbereiche SEO, SEA, Social Advertising & Content Marketing und fungierst als interner Analytics-Sparringspartner
Du informierst dich über aktuelle Trends und Entwicklungen im eigenen Fachbereich und bringst eigene Ideen in tägliche Arbeitsabläufe und Projekte ein
Die Durchführung von internen und externen Workshops sowie Präsentationen gehört ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabengebiet


Dein Profil


Idealerweise besitzt du 2-3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der digitalen Analyse und interessierst dich für die Welt des Online Marketing
Du hast dein Studium, z.B. mit Schwerpunkt (Online) Marketing, Datenanalyse oder verwandten Fächern, bzw. gleichwertige Qualifikation bereits erfolgreich abgeschlossen
Du besitzt ein gutes Zahlenverständnis und analytisches Denken sowie Interesse an technischen Implementierungen
Du überzeugst durch exzellente Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Der Fokus dieser Stelle liegt auf der Betreuung unseres deutschsprachigen Kundenstamms. Du solltest dich daher in der deutschen Sprachen so wohl fühlen, dass du komplexe Beratungsgespräche und die schriftliche Kommunikation sicher auf Deutsch führen kannst.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse des Google Tag Managers sowie Google Analytics 4 und arbeitest routiniert mit Data Studio (ehem. Looker Studio)
Praktische Erfahrung mit Google BigQuery ist von Vorteil
Ebenfalls sind Grundkenntnisse in SQL oder Python ein Plus
Ein hohes Maß an Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative und Teamfähigkeit, sowie Spaß daran, dich in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten, rundet dein Profil ab


Was wir dir bieten


Flexibilität: Wähle das Arbeitsmodell, das zu dir passt und arbeite entweder in unserem Berliner Office oder an einem Ort deiner Wahl in Deutschland. Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du auch remote im Ausland arbeiten.
Individuelle Entwicklung: Dein persönliches Wachstum ist uns wichtig! Wir gestalten gemeinsam deinen individuellen Entwicklungsplan und besprechen ihn in regelmäßigen Feedbackmeetings.
Peak Ace Academy: Nutze unsere internen und externen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, um deine Entwicklungsziele zu erreichen und deinen eigenen Karriereweg zu formen.
Work-Life-Balance: Finde deinen idealen Rhythmus mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitoptionen und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr (Heiligabend und Neujahr sind zusätzliche freie Tage).
Vielfältige Kund:innen: Arbeite mit internationalen Kund:innen aus verschiedenen Branchen an innovativen Kampagnen und bringe deine Ideen ein, um gemeinsam zu wachsen und Digital Marketing neu zu denken.
Vergünstigungen: Spare bei zahlreichen Shops und anderen Anbietern über unser Corporate-Benefits Portal.
Gemeinsam stark: Werde Teil eines Teams aus einzigartigen und leidenschaftlichen Digital-Marketing-Expert:innen. Zusammen arbeitet ihr an herausfordernden Projekten, könnt euch austauschen und voneinander lernen.
An die Zukunft denken: Peak Ace bezuschusst deinen Sparbeitrag zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit zusätzlichen 20 %.
Office-Leben: In unserem Berliner Office findest du alles, was du zum Arbeiten brauchst – erstklassige technische Ausstattung, Obst, Getränke und viel Platz für die Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Kolleg:innen.


Fühlst du dich angesprochen?

Dann freuen wir uns über die Zusendung deiner aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Gehaltswunsch, nächstmöglicher Eintrittstermin) über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular.

Über uns

Die 2007 gegründete Peak Ace AG ist eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Digital-Marketing-Agentur mit Sitz in Berlin sowie Standorten in Paris und Nantes. Mit über 170 Mitarbeiter:innen realisiert das Team Kampagnen in mehr als 25 Sprachen auf muttersprachlichem Niveau.

Im Fokus steht die Entwicklung einzigartiger digitaler Erlebnisse – von Paid Advertising (PPC), SEO und Content Marketing bis hin zu Digitalstrategie und spezialisierten KI-Lösungen wie z. B. KI-gestütztes Brand Monitoring und LLM-Consulting. Peak Ace liefert maßgeschneiderte, leistungsstarke Lösungen für namhafte Kund:innen wie Airbnb, TUI und AutoScout24.

2023 wurde die Agentur unter anderem zur „SEO Agency of the Year“ und „Multi-Territory Agency of the Year“ gekürt. Für ihre Unternehmenskultur erhielt sie mehrere Auszeichnungen wie den „Best Agency Culture“-Award. Weitere Preise wie „Most Innovative Campaign“ und „Best Use of Search“ unterstreichen die Kreativität und Kompetenz von Peak Ace.

Title: Sortimentscontroller (m/w/d) Einkauf/Marketing
Description:
Wir sind seit Jahren Deutschlands führender Schreibwaren-Filialist. Mit rund 1500 freundlichen und kompetenten Mitarbeitern betreiben wir rund 270 modern gestaltete Filialen.

Wir suchen für unsere Zentrale in Berlin zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Sortimentscontroller (m/w/d) im Bereich Einkauf/Marketing.

Ihre Aufgaben:

·         Kontinuierliche Analyse und Bewertung der Performance unseres Sortiments sowie Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen auf Artikel-, Warengruppen- und Filialebene

·         Entwicklung aussagekräftiger Kennzahlen und Auswertungen zu Umsatz, Absatz, Rohertrag, Bestand und weiteren relevanten Sortimentskennzahlen

·         Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung unseres Sortiments

·         Unterstützung bei der Bestandssteuerung und Analyse von Warenbeständen, Reichweiten, Überbeständen und Warenverfügbarkeiten mit dem Ziel, eine bedarfsgerechte Warenversorgung unserer Filialen sicherzustellen

·         Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung bestehender Reports und Steuerungsinstrumente, insbesondere mit MS Excel sowie Power Query und Power Pivot

·         Zusammenführung, Aufbereitung und Analyse von Daten aus unterschiedlichen internen Systemen und Datenquellen

·          Bewertung von Sortimentsveränderungen, Neueinführungen und Aktionen sowie Überprüfung ihres wirtschaftlichen Erfolgs

·         Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Vertrieb und Warenwirtschaft bei sortimentsrelevanten Fragestellungen

Ihr Profil:

·         Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Berufsausbildung, ein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

·         Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung – gerne auch im Rahmen einer Werkstudententätigkeit oder eines Praktikums – im Sortimentscontrolling, in der Warensteuerung, Disposition, im Einkauf oder in einer vergleichbaren analytischen Funktion, vorzugsweise im Handel

·         Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel, idealerweise einschließlich Power Query und Power Pivot sowie Erfahrung in der Verknüpfung und Aufbereitung von Daten aus unterschiedlichen Datenquellen

·         Idealerweise Grundkenntnisse in SQL und im Umgang mit Datenbanken bzw. größeren Datenbeständen

·         Ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität und Freude an der Analyse und Auswertung größerer Datenmengen

·         Unternehmerisches Denken sowie eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

·         Hohes persönliches Engagement, Eigeninitiative und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität

Das bieten wir:

25 % Mitarbeiterrabatt in unseren Filialen
Dauerhafte Preisnachlässe bei über 800 Top-Markenanbietern in unserem Vorteilsportal
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Umfassende und praxisnahe Einarbeitung
Einblicke in die zentralen Abläufe und Zusammenhänge eines erfolgreichen Handelsunternehmens
Ein kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und starkem Teamzusammenhalt
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen
Berufliche Weiterentwicklung bei überdurchschnittlichem Erfolg

Title: Senior Analyst | Energy Practice | Berlin
Description:
Who We Are

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our extensive expertise in the various Energy market ranges from market design & regulatory issues, strategy development and market modelling to comprehensive expert work in civil and antitrust / competition proceedings and carrying out due diligences for transactions. We work with utilities, energy infrastructure operators, large end-users of energy, energy regulators, law firms and investors.

You will work on both quantitative modelling and regulatory issues through a range of international projects.

Our EMEA Energy Team, With 60 Professionals Across Europe, Is At The Forefront Of The Transformation Of Energy Markets. We Advise Governments, Regulators, Energy Companies, Financial Investors, And Legal Counsels On Issues Spanning


Market design and regulation of electricity, gas and hydrogen markets across the entire value chain; due diligence and IPO support
Energy transition strategies, climate policy, carbon markets, and decarbonisation pathways
Industrial decarbonisation and industrial competitiveness
Valuation of energy assets and investment decisions for utilities, infrastructure funds, and industrials
Market and financial modelling
Competition and State aid investigations
Regulatory and commercial disputes, including arbitration and litigation support
Expert support during disputes and arbitrations


Our company is global and our EMEA Energy Team focuses on Europe, Africa and the Middle East.

Our work combines cutting-edge economic research, deep energy sector expertise with applied market and financial modelling to help clients navigate the rapid transformation of energy systems.

Our recent public studies include, among others, a report for Business Europe on European competitiveness in the energy and climate transition, a report for Eurelectric on the evolution of system flexibility needs and the evolving concept of security of supply, a report for Naturgy Foundation on the evolution of the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and a report for the Clean Air Task Force on the deployment of clean power technologies.

Due to expansion of our Energy practice in the German-speaking region, we are currently looking for a Consultant or Senior Consultant with several years of professional experience in consulting, with regulatory authorities or with energy utilities.

You will work on both quantitative modelling and regulatory issues across the DACH region, and projects all over Europe. You can be located in any of our European offices (i.e. Berlin, Düsseldorf, Paris, Brussels, London and Helsinki) and will continuously work with colleagues in other offices.

Typical Duties Will Include


Quantitative analysis using our energy-specific models and using our energy system modelling platforms.
Preparation of reports and summaries of analysis.
Active participation in client meetings and conference calls.
Participation in our business development efforts


Benefits Of Your Career At Compass Lexecon


A competitive salary with additional benefits
A variety of interesting and challenging projects
Client interaction and responsibility from day one
Excellent development opportunities
An international team from a variety of backgrounds and experiences
A steep learning curve, in a supportive and collaborative team
Comprehensive training programs


Experience And Skills Required


2 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in consulting, with regulatory authorities or in energy utilities
Master’s degree in Economics, Engineering, Finance or Statistics from a leading university
Fluency in German and English languages (both spoken and written)
Other European languages (particularly French) are desirable
Advanced Excel, PowerPoint and Word skills
Experience in energy and particularly power system modelling is a bonus
Working knowledge of statistical packages (R, Stata) or programming languages (Python, VBA, etc.) is a bonus
Commitment to high-quality and accurate work
Strong solution orientation and analytical skills
Good organisational skills and ability to prioritize
Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and clients
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment


For An Informal Discussion On This Position, Please Contact


Gerald Aue (Vice President, Paris, Berlin and Vienna) at gaue@compasslexecon.com
Anton Burger (Vice President, Berlin) at ABurger@compasslexecon.com

Title: Senior Product Analyst - EA Sports FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this is a regular full-time (hybrid) role. Qualified applicants must be available to work in the Vancouver studio 3x per week. Canadian work authorization is required.

Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

About Binance.US:

Binance.US is a licensed and regulated U.S. cryptocurrency exchange where users can buy, trade, hold, and earn digital assets. Recognized as a top U.S. crypto platform by Forbes (Best Crypto Exchanges of 2026) and Business Insider (Best Crypto Exchanges of 2025), Binance.US leads the industry with its low fees, advanced trading engine, strong security and reliability, and robust compliance framework. Learn more at www.binance.us. All roles supporting Binance.US are employed via BAM Management US Holdings Inc. or BAM Management Canada Holdings Inc.

About This Role

Binance.US, one of the most recognized brands in cryptocurrency, is looking for a Senior Growth Data Analyst to join our Data organization as a dedicated partner to the Marketing team. You'll sit within Data — with the rigor, tooling, and standards that come with it — while working day-to-day alongside performance, lifecycle, brand, and growth teams to shape and measure marketing strategy. This is a high-ownership individual-contributor role for someone who wants to build the analytical foundation a fast-growing marketing org needs, and to influence where and how we invest. As the function matures, there's a clear path for this role to grow a team underneath it.

What You'll Do


Serve as the embedded data partner to Marketing, bringing rigorous, data-driven decision-making to a team that today lacks dedicated analytical support.
Stand up and own the marketing measurement foundation across AppsFlyer, GA4, Firebase and Braze: event tracking plans, QA with Product and Engineering, unified attribution windows, and KPI frameworks.
Connect that data into clean, reconciled datasets in the warehouse, so channels can be compared apples-to-apples and discrepancies are caught and fixed.
Develop self-serve dashboards and recurring reporting that give Marketing and leadership clear visibility into performance.
Analyze the full funnel (acquisition → activation → engagement → retention → monetization), surface the highest-impact growth opportunities, and size them.
Design, run, and read out experiments and A/B tests across acquisition and the customer lifecycle, and set the experimentation standard for the marketing org.
Build and maintain the core models that drive spend decisions: LTV, ROAS, CAC/payback, and retention; translate them into channel strategy and budget allocation recommendations.
Translate analysis into clear, persuasive recommendations, and influence marketing investment decisions with stakeholders up to leadership.


What You'll Bring


4-7 years in marketing/growth analytics or data science, ideally at a consumer-facing tech, fintech, or startup, with a track record of driving measurable growth.
Hands-on experience with AppsFlyer and GA4/Firebase, from tracking plans to raw data exports.
Advanced SQL and comfort working with large-scale data in modern warehouse environments.
Strong grounding in marketing attribution, experimentation and statistics, funnel analysis, retention, ARPU, and LTV.
Proficiency with BI/visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar).
Clear communicator who turns analysis into recommendations for Marketing and leadership.
A self-starter comfortable building from scratch in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.


Nice to have


Crypto, fintech, or financial services experience.
Python or R for analysis and modeling.
Prior experience building LTV or retention models.
Experience building audience segments and activating warehouse data into ad platforms.
Bachelor's in a quantitative field.


Salary:

The starting pay range for this role is between CAD $123,768 - CAD $140,327 per year for all Canadian remote locations and between USD$131,760 - $154,200 per year for all U.S. remote locations. The actual base pay will vary, and is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skill sets, work experience, business needs, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change.

Title: Operations Data Analyst
Description:
ABOUT 49North

49North is a Canadian defence company delivering secure, multi-domain C4ISR capabilities that provide decision advantage in complex and contested environments. A wholly-owned subsidiary of MDA Space, building on more than five decades of trusted Canadian defence delivery, 49North operates as a sovereign Canadian provider of mission-critical C4ISR systems, bringing disciplined prime-contractor execution to defence and security programs.

Visit 49North | An MDA Space Company.

49North is rooted in the execution of large, complex, and mission-critical programs developed within 49NORTH. This legacy reflects a record of delivery where engineering rigour, operational reliability, and national trust are non-negotiable.

49North Defence strengthens Canada’s sovereign defence capability by delivering integrated mission systems and multi-domain C4ISR integration, enabling trusted Canadian and coalition operations, assured interoperability, and sustained readiness.

Role

The role of Operations Data Analyst reports to the Director, Mission Assurance and resides within the Administration function of the larger Programs & Operations Team of 49North, an MDA Space business. As an Operations Data Analyst, you will work with business stakeholders to realize business intelligence through structured data analysis, processing and visualization. This role also includes Process Specialist responsibilities, you will work with process stakeholders to define, realize (implement), deploy and maintain in-scope processes as well as administrate supporting systems, notably the 49North Business Process System (BPS). As an ISO 9001 certified Quality System and plans to implement Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), you will help continuously improve select enterprise systems to meet local needs and assist in the deployment of OneMDA Corporate improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities of the Operations Data Analyst includes those associated with continual improvement as a Process Specialist. In terms of data analysis, two aspects are considered: business intelligence initiation and business intelligence realization.

Business Intelligence Initiation

Works With Business Leadership And Performs The Following


Identifies the means to quantitatively or qualitatively support assessment of key business objectives and their corresponding Critical Success Factors through identification of Key Performance Indicators and associated metrics
Creates plans describing the bringing together of data sources, working with Corporate stakeholders (e.g. IT) as necessary


Business Intelligence Realization


Identifies and assesses data sources for suitability and takes actions to remediate data quality and integrity as necessary
Connects data sources in a way that enables collective analysis
Develops dashboards, reports and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights to performance
Performs analyses identifying trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities for improvement
Provides and/or presents evidence-based data interpretations and recommendations


In terms of continual improvement, two aspects are considered: facilitating implementation and change initiatives and administrating supporting systems.

Implementation and Change Initiatives Facilitation

Sources of improvement efforts can include ongoing activities (e.g. maintaining the BPS), local business initiatives (e.g. implementing CMMI), and enabling the deployment of Corporate-sponsored OneMDA initiatives.


Collaborates with leaders and subject matter experts to understand business challenges and information needs
Administrates the identification, prioritization and effort reporting of process improvement initiatives
Assesses processes (e.g. preforms value stream mapping), including creating as-is and to-be depictions of process, to identify and eliminate inefficiencies, waste, and ineffectiveness
Facilitates discovery activities working with process stakeholders and subject matter experts
Creates/revises process descriptions (e.g. procedures) and associated process artifacts (e.g. forms, templates) and training materials


Supporting Systems Administration


Establishes and maintains the process improvement roadmap reflecting the priorities of Operational Excellence and, as applicable, upgrades to the content of the BPS
Maintains the BPS through the evaluation of process Change Requests (CRs) and administration of Change Control Board (CCB) meetings with Process Owners
Participates in the review of Lessons Learned reports to identify potential opportunities for improvement (OFIs)
Leads the disposition of OFI records
Serves as the local MS SharePoint administrator and maintains the BPS infrastructure and associated instructional information on use and administration of the BPS
Performs process change impact assessments for proposed or planned changes
Establishes and maintains a process improvement performance dashboard and periodically reports on process improvement performance


Requirements (experience/skills)


A two- or three-year accredited diploma or certificate program in data analysis
Minimum 2 years of experience in the definition, implementation, maintenance and administration of business processes
Working knowledge of and administrator-level hands-on experience with Power BI
Experience with database management systems and related query language, notably SQL
Microsoft SharePoint site-level administrator experience including HTML and Java scripting capabilities
Experience with a structured change implementation methodology as applied to business processes is required. Experience in process value-stream mapping is considered an asset
Willingness to extend one’s own technical capabilities through learning
Experience working within a quality management system or an ISO- or CMMI-certified workplace is considered an asset
Experience working with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g. Infor LN) is considered an asset
History of taking the initiative while diplomatically keeping leadership stakeholders informed along the way
Strong interpersonal skills, particularly in the areas of peer collaboration and teamwork; comfortable interfacing with the senior management team and able to ‘sell’ improvement initiatives
Proven communication skills with an ability to present to multiple stakeholder groups and achieve their buy-in for improvement initiatives


We’re a dream team of purpose-driven, collaborative and passionate people, and we are constantly looking for others to join 49North to ignite new and innovative approaches to problem-solving that push us forward.

Comments/Special Considerations

Successful candidates must obtain and hold Canadian security clearance at the secret level, and pass security assessment for the Controlled Goods Program (CGP).

Benefits Statement

49North provides competitive compensation and benefits packages for its employees at all locations. As a team member of 49North, you and your qualified dependents are eligible to participate in a benefit plan that ensures a comprehensive level of protection through competitive health care including; extended healthcare and flexible drug plans, dental and vision benefits, disability income protection, life insurance, group retirement savings plans; and an employee and family assistance program.

Equal Opportunity Statement

49North is an equal opportunity employer prizing diversity and inclusion. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity. If you require assistance and/or reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please feel free to notify us.

Accommodations

49North is proud to provide accommodation(s) during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodations, please indicate this on your application/cover letter and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

The compensation range for this position is $75,000.00 - $102,000.00 annually. The specific compensation offered will be based on the qualifications and experience of the successful candidate.

Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.

At Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group, we’re "invested in our greatest asset, you". Our shared goals reflect what matters most to our people:


Your community: we foster belonging through collaboration, inclusion and flexibility. Enjoy social events, volunteering and a strong commitment to corporate social responsibility. Title: Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt
Description:
About QuadReal Property Group

QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships.

QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come.

QuadReal: Excellence lives here.

www.quadreal.com

Role Description:

The Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt (12 month Contract) will report directly to the Director, Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with a background in Data Science or Data Analytics who is looking to develop their career in an entrepreneurial and high-energy environment. Embedded within the business, this role supports management reporting, forecasting, and portfolio analysis across the RE Debt portfolio, in addition to being the primary liaison to ED&A and IT — translating reporting requirements into data specifications and building data flows from the Enterprise Data Platform through to the reporting layer. This position also works closely with the Real Estate Debt Investment, Accounting, and Operations teams, FP&A, and Portfolio Management teams across QuadReal.

Role Description:


Support scenario modelling, cash flow forecasting, leverage and liquidity analysis through Anaplan, supplemented by ad-hoc financial models as needed, using AI-assisted development for efficiency and quality control
Analyze portfolio exposures, return attribution, and market trends, and support the development of presentation materials with AIenhanced insights and visualization
Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly and ad hoc management reports for senior management, Board of Directors and BCI
Support real estate debt investment underwriting by providing portfolio impact analysis
Assist with ad hoc research projects for benchmarking, peer analysis, risk analysis, and other relevant topics
Query and extract data from enterprise data platforms to support portfolio reporting and analytics needs
Develop and maintain business logic, portfolio calculations, and data transformation rules that underpin reporting outputs
Serve as the primary business-side liaison to IT and ED&A, translating reporting requirements into data specifications and validating platform outputs
Support data enablement initiatives and ongoing data management and governance priorities across the RE Debt portfolio
Validate and reconcile data collected from different systems using AI-powered anomaly detection to improve data quality and identify process improvement opportunities


Experience And Qualifications:


University degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field) OR a background in Economics, Finance or a related business field. CFA or similar designation is a plus
2–3 years of experience working in a data analyst role, ideally in investment management or real estate.
Analytical – Strong quantitative and analytical skills; detail-oriented and proficient in building and handling complicated data sets.
Excellent communication and presentation skills; demonstrates an ability to effectively communicate and present results that articulate key themes and messages.
Must be able to allocate time effectively and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines, handle multiple demands and competing priorities, and adapt to new ideas and change. Comfortable following direction but also contributing to the direction.
Advanced knowledge of SQL, Power Query, Excel, and Power BI is required. Familiarity with Anaplan or a similar planning tool is an asset. Experience with Tableau or Python is considered a plus.
Proactive approach to leveraging technology for process improvement and analytical enhancement. Comfortable learning and applying new tools, automation techniques, GenAI applications (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot), and advanced analytics platforms to solve complex problems, automate data analysis, rapidly prototype financial models, and deliver higher-quality insights.
Has a questioning frame of mind, asks “why” and challenges the status quo with improvements to drive change when needed.


The expected annualized base salary range for this role is $74,000-$84,000.

The actual salary offered will take into consideration a wide array of factors including, but not limited to, the individual’s skill, experience, education and training, the market compensation of the role, and the consideration to internal equity.

We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Even if your skills don’t align 100% with the listed qualifications or salary range, we encourage you to apply – you may be a great fit for this role or others in our community. Applicants may also be considered for alternative positions within the organization where their qualifications and experience align more closely with available opportunities.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) technology — alongside human review — to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this position. Our recruitment team remains involved in all decisions.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada as the company does not provide work permit sponsorship for this role.

Note to Recruiters: QuadReal does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to QuadReal, directly or indirectly, will be considered QuadReal property. QuadReal will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. A recruiting agency must first have a valid, written and fully executed agency agreement contract for engaged services to submit resumes.

QuadReal Property Group will provide reasonable accommodation at any time throughout the hiring process for applicants with disabilities or for those needing job postings in an alternate format. If you require accommodation, please advise the Talent Acquisition team member you are working with and include the following: Job posting #, your name and your preferred method of contact.

Title: Business Analyst, Data & Analytics
Description:
BC Cancer

Vancouver, BC

Reporting to Manager/Director in Data and Analytics, the Business Analyst, Data & Evaluation, works in close collaboration with program leaders. The Business Analyst provides ongoing review, analysis and reporting of data from existing and emerging activities, services and initiatives, while ensuring data is valid, reliable and complete. The Business Analyst performs data analyses to generate comprehensive and valid reports. The Business Analyst will contribute to patient safety and quality initiatives, by providing data and metrics related to the strategic goals and performance of the program. The Business Analyst supports a variety of internal and external stakeholders in the planning of data and evaluation strategies related to quality improvement initiatives.

What You’ll Do


Develop and produce program evaluation performance metrics and tools to provide accurate and high quality analysis of key indicators, including outcomes, quality and safety, data standards, in ensuring continuous quality improvement for BC Cancer.
Ensure internal, external and public reporting needs are met by gathering and negotiating reporting requirements from customers and stakeholders, communicating requirements to technical resources and following up with stakeholders regularly to develop and implement an examination process for the final reports.
Analyze operational problems and recommend innovative solutions by critically evaluating information gathered from multiple sources, reconciling conflicts, decomposing high-level information into details, abstracting up from low-level information to a general understanding, distinguishing user requests from the underlying true needs, and driving and challenging business assumptions.
Work in collaboration with program leaders and provincial partners to monitor program plans, measure progress towards goals and objectives, and identify the key factors that account for any deviation from stated goals and objectives.
Identify issues with complex data and takes initiative in working out optimal solutions with appropriate stakeholders to improve accuracy, timelines, coordination and other data issues.
Develop reports, dashboards, presentations and briefing documents for multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Provide health planning, program development, and project management support for new initiatives and business cases. Provide leadership in the development of processes to analyze the functionality and effectiveness of program delivery and recommend improvements.
Keep up-to-date about new initiatives, developments, trends and best practice in evaluation and monitoring through literature reviews and contact with key stakeholders from other organizations. Communicate information and make recommendations to program leaders.


Qualifications

What you bring


A level of education, training and experience equivalent to a Master’s degree in Business, Analytics, Health Informatics, Health Sciences, or related discipline plus a minimum of five (5) years of recent experience in complex data analysis, health evaluation, project/program management, preferably in a large, multi-site health care environment.
Demonstrated knowledge of the historic and ongoing impacts of settler colonialism on Indigenous Peoples in social and health contexts, including supported by significant knowledge of Indigenous-specific mandates, including clear understanding of and commitment to eradicate Indigenous-specific racism and discrimination and embed Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility.
Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of the historic and ongoing impacts of settler colonialism and systemic racism on Indigenous Peoples within social and health contexts. This includes understanding how these factors contribute to current health disparities and barriers to care. Show a clear commitment to identifying, challenging, and eradicating Indigenous-specific racism and all forms of discrimination impacting equity-deserving groups within health care settings. This involves familiarity and understanding Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility recognizing personal biases, institutional barriers, engaging in anti-racism education and training and advocating for systemic change.
Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of legislative obligations and provincial commitments within Business Analytics contexts found in the foundational documents including Truth & Reconciliation Commission’s Calls to Action (2015), In Plain Sight (2020), BC's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (2019), United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP), Reclaiming Power and Place Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women & Girls Calls for Justice (2019), the Declaration Act Action Plan and Remembering Keegan: A First Nations Case Study - BC Human Rights Code, BC Anti-racism Act and how they intersect across the health care system.


Core Competencies


Brings an understanding of the Indigenous specific racism and the broader systemic racism that exists in the colonial health care structure, and has demonstrated initiatives in breaking down barriers and ensuring a safe environment ensuring a sense of belonging to all and informed by Indigenous Cultural Safety.
Awareness of social, economic, political and historical realities of settler colonialism on Indigenous Peoples and familiarity with addressing Indigenous-specific anti-racism, anti-racism and Indigenous Cultural Safety and foundational documents and legislative commitments (the Declaration Act, the Declaration Action Plan, TRC, IPS, Remembering Keegan, etc.).


Skills & Knowledge


Demonstrated ability to perform accurate advanced data manipulation, analysis, and information presentation using Microsoft Office suite, database and statistical software.
Knowledge and experience in project management, strategic planning and project implementation.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated ability in preparing professional reports and presentation materials.
Ability to work under pressure and multi-task without supervision.
Ability to communicate complex and technical ideas in simple language.
Demonstrated ability to exercise tact, good judgment and initiative.
Demonstrates a commitment to beginning and/or continuing their personal learning journey related to Indigenous-specific racism and dismantling systems of oppression, as well as addressing racism more broadly. Shows willingness to articulate and share their learning experiences to contribute to a culture of motivation and inspiration among peers.
Demonstrates foundational knowledge of the social, economic, and political realities of settler-colonialism and its impacts on Indigenous peoples and equity-deserving groups within social and health contexts. Understands the impact of social determinants of health-on-health outcomes. Shows a commitment to learning about and upholding legislative obligations and provincial commitments outlined in foundational documents such as the Truth & Reconciliation Commission’s Calls to Action (2015), In Plain Sight (2020), BC's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (2019), United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP), Reclaiming Power and Place: Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women & Girls Calls for Justice (2019), the Declaration Act Action Plan, Remembering Keegan: A First Nations Case Study, the BC Human Rights Code, Anti-Racism Data Act, and the Distinctions Based Approach.


What We Bring

Every PHSA employee enables the best possible patient care for our patients and their families. Whether you are providing direct care, conducting research, or making it possible for others to do their work, you impact the lives of British Columbians today and in the future.
