Title: Analyst/Administrative Assistant
Description:
Come work as an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH) on the Richmond Community Administration team. Apply now to join the team!

As an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health you will:


Provide analytical support to the Program team for purposes such as data analysis, statistical reporting, benchmarking activities, developing and generating queries, preparing and compiling reports and technical documents utilizing various software and tools.
Provide confidential administrative and secretarial assistance and research support to the Director and to the IWMS team.
Maintain the Manager and management team’s appointment calendars, coordinate meetings, process and prioritize information, screen, triage and act upon requests and inquiries, including confidential and sensitive information.
Work independently and interface with other Executive Directors, Managers and staff at all levels of the organization.
Effectively partner with other VCH departments and liaises on behalf of the department with external agencies to coordinate the flow of information, keeping the Director apprised of relevant issues and activities.


This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

As per Ministry of Health policy, all health care workers working in publicly-funded health care facilities are required to report their past receipt of certain vaccines or history of certain infections. Collecting these records will allow for offering of any missing vaccines, and for appropriate actions to be taken in the event of any future exposure to a communicable disease or during outbreaks. For all new hires and appointments to Vancouver Coastal Health, you will be asked to provide this information as part of the onboarding process.

WHY JOIN VANCOUVER COASTAL HEALTH?

VCH is a world class innovator in medical care, research and teaching, delivering service to more than one million BC residents. At VCH, we embrace thinking boldly, taking smart risks, and 'going first' when we believe it will lead to the best possible outcomes for patients and their families. We invite you to join us in creating healthy lives in healthy communities by showcasing our passion for care, connection to the communities we serve and our culture of teamwork that makes VCH a great place to work.


Comprehensive health benefits package, including MSP, extended health and dental and municipal pension plan
Grow your career with employer-paid training and leadership development opportunities
Wellness supports, including counselling, critical incident and innovative wellness services are available to employees and their immediate families
Award-winning recognition programs to honour staff, medical staff and volunteers
Access to exclusive discount offers and deals for VCH staff


At Vancouver Coastal Health, our vision of healthy lives in healthy communities inspires us and our values and pillars guide us. We support equitable practices, diverse teams and inclusive environments, which are vital to creating welcoming spaces where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and feel supported. We encourage applications from equity-deserving communities, including Indigenous Peoples and members of racialized groups, people with disabilities and people of all gender identities and expressions and sexual orientation.

Vancouver Coastal Health is proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, BC’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers and Canada's Top Employers for Young People in 2026.

Only short-listed applicants will be contacted for this posting.

Thank you for your interest in Vancouver Coastal Health.

Diploma in a related program plus three to four (3-4) years' recent, related experience in a complex health care environment with progressively more responsible secretarial and administrative positions supporting senior level management, experience in information analysis and benchmarking, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Advanced computer skills in spreadsheet, database, graphics and word processing programs is required, e.g. Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio.

Freybe Gourmet Foods is looking for a data-driven, commercially minded Category Manager to join our team on an 18-month contract.




In this role, you'll turn market trends, consumer insights, retailer data, and sales analytics into strategies that drive growth. Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive activity.


Identify opportunities for growth, innovation, pricing, and assortment improvements.


Develop category strategies that support business objectives.



Support Retail Partners



Deliver category reviews, insights, and recommendations to retail customers.


Support sales presentations with data-driven storytelling.


Recommend assortment, promotion, and merchandising opportunities.



Turn Data Into Action



Manage and analyze syndicated, retailer, and internal sales data.


Create dashboards, reports, and performance reviews.


Translate complex information into clear recommendations for leadership and cross-functional teams.



Lead Competitive & Market Analysis



Monitor competitor activity, innovation, pricing, promotions, and market trends.


Deliver quarterly category reviews highlighting what is changing in the market and what actions Freybe should consider.



Partner Across the Business



Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Innovation teams.


Support new product launches and business planning with data-backed insights and forecasts.



What We're Looking ForExperience



5+ years of experience in Category Management, Retail Analytics, or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG).


Experience working with retailers and category review processes.


Food industry experience is an asset.



Skills



Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Excellent presentation and communication skills.


Ability to transform data into actionable business insights.


Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.



Technical Skills



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.


Experience with Nielsen, Circana (IRI), or similar syndicated data platforms.


Power BI or Tableau experience is an asset.



Education



Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.


MBA or advanced analytics training is considered an asset.



Additional Requirements



Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle.


Ability to travel as required.


Eligible to work full-time in Canada.


Minimum of 4 days per week in office.



Why Join Freybe?


At Freybe, you'll have the opportunity to influence key business decisions, work directly with leading retailers, and help shape category strategies for some of Canada's most recognized premium food products.




This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytics, strategy, and customer collaboration to make a measurable impact.

Job Summary

The Department of Psychiatry at the University of British Columbia invites applications for a full-time Research Computing Analyst with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning and scientific computing. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sophia Frangou, President’s Chair in Brain Health, and will receive detailed instructions on assignments. The successful candidate will carry out programming and technical tasks, troubleshoot computational problems, and contribute to the development and implementation of solutions under the guidance of senior members of the research team. Work will be reviewed for accuracy, completeness and timeliness.

The successful applicant will primarily contribute to the CentileBrain Project. This is a computational neuroimaging initiative focused on individual-level brain characterization. It combines large-scale imaging data, normative modelling, harmonization and machine learning. The platform generates individualized centile and deviation scores across the lifespan. The goal is to support precision neuroscience and clinically meaningful individual inference.

Organizational Status

The Department of Psychiatry at the University of British Columbia invites applications for a full-time Research Computing Analyst with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning and scientific computing. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sophia Frangou, President’s Chair in Brain Health, and will receive detailed instructions on assignments. The successful candidate will carry out programming and technical tasks, troubleshoot computational problems, and contribute to the development and implementation of solutions under the guidance of senior members of the research team. Work will be reviewed for accuracy, completeness and timeliness

Work Performed


Oversees the implementation of established machine-learning, artificial-intelligence and statistical methods in research datasets, modifies existing scripts as required using detailed specifications, and recommends computational workflow modifications to the PI.
Performs data preparation, quality control, feature extraction and other defined computational tasks for large-scale research studies.
Integrates multimodal datasets using established analytical procedures and modifies existing code as required to support data compatibility and processing.
Runs and maintains computational workflows on local and high-performance computing systems, including monitoring processing and addressing routine execution issues.
Resolve routine technical problems in code, data processing and computational workflows and escalate new issues for consultation with senior team members.
Provides first-level technical support to research team members using established computational workflows and systems.
Maintains clear documentation of code and script modifications, analytical procedures, software versions, testing results and computational outputs.


Consequence of Error/Judgement

The Principal Investigator will provide oversight for this position. Given the importance of the work to the research program, errors or poor judgment could substantially compromise research quality, delay project completion, and adversely affect future funding opportunities. Inaccurate or ineffective representation of the team’s work could also damage relationships with funding agencies and collaborators. The position therefore requires consistently high standards of accuracy, judgment, efficiency, and communication.

Supervision Received

The successful candidate will work within the broad direction established by the Principal Investigator and research team, with a high degree of independence and minimal supervision. The successful candidate will be expected to exercise sound judgment in carrying out defined responsibilities, collaborate effectively with team members, and proactively identify and bring emerging issues, risks, or unusual circumstances to the attention of the Principal Investigator.

Supervision Given

The successful candidate may assign tasks to students and provide oversight and review of their work.

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of one year of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.


Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications


An undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, statistics or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience with analyses of human neuroimaging MRI data
Strong programming skills
Demonstrated experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence or advanced statistical modelling.
Experience working with high-dimensional or complex biomedical, biological or scientific datasets.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Note: Candidates are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas. We are particularly interested in applicants who combine strong computational skills with the ability and interest to apply them to human neuroscience and biomedical research

Title: Analyste de l’information
Description:
La personne titulaire est chargée de mener des enquêtes fondées sur le renseignement de sources ouvertes afin d’appuyer les activités de la Mise en application de l’OCRI. Son rôle ne se limite pas à la collecte de données : il consiste également à interpréter et à synthétiser des renseignements complexes provenant de diverses sources, à dégager des tendances, des liens et des constatations clés qui orientent la stratégie relative aux dossiers et ouvrent de nouvelles pistes d’enquête. La personne titulaire transforme des données brutes et des éléments de preuve en renseignement clair donnant matière à intervention disciplinaire. En collaboration avec les équipes de la Mise en application, elle joue un rôle essentiel dans l’avancement des enquêtes par l’exercice de son jugement analytique, le maintien de l’intégrité des données et la gestion de multiples priorités dans un environnement dynamique axé sur les dossiers.

Principales responsabilités

Enquêtes


Mener des enquêtes approfondies sur les sociétés autorisées et les personnes autorisées en réponse aux plaintes du public (dont celles traitées par l’Évaluation des dossiers de l’OCRI), en réalisant des recherches exhaustives à partir du renseignement de sources ouvertes.
Consulter des bases de données internes et externes, des sources ouvertes et les médias sociaux afin de recueillir, de valider et d’analyser le renseignement pertinent.


Analyse et soutien à la Mise en application


Collaborer avec les équipes de la Mise en application en organisant, en interprétant et en présentant des données et des éléments de preuve à l’appui des dossiers en cours, y compris en préparant des pièces matérielles et en présentant les constatations à la direction et aux collègues.
Au moyen des outils logiciels disponibles, recueillir et analyser des renseignements complexes, produire des visualisations de données et rédiger des rapports de renseignement clairs mettant en évidence les principales constatations, les tendances observées, les lacunes relevées et les mesures à prendre recommandées afin de soutenir la prise de décisions à l’égard des enquêtes et les mesures disciplinaires.
Soutenir les procédures disciplinaires en témoignant lors d’audiences, au besoin.


Développement de la fonction de renseignement


Participer aux réunions d’équipe et contribuer aux projets d’amélioration continue en proposant des démarches novatrices concernant les pratiques, les processus et l’efficacité opérationnelle globale du renseignement.
Repérer les lacunes en matière de renseignement, les difficultés à relever dans les enquêtes, les liens entre les sources d’information ainsi que les occasions de renforcer les stratégies d’enquête.
Concevoir et tenir à jour des outils de suivi des données (p. ex. systèmes de gestion de la relation client [GRC], feuilles de calcul Excel et tableaux de bord Power BI), effectuer la saisie et l’agrégation des données, et améliorer continuellement les flux de travaux et les processus d’analyse afin d’accroître l’efficacité et d’améliorer les résultats des enquêtes.
Développer et maintenir une fine connaissance des systèmes de l’OCRI, des sources de données, des outils d’analyse (p. ex. systèmes de GRC, Excel, i2, Power BI et logiciels de renseignement de sources ouvertes) ainsi que des technologies émergentes grâce à du perfectionnement professionnel continu et à l’apprentissage autonome.
Établir des relations de travail efficaces avec les parties prenantes en matière de réglementation et les autorités compétentes d’autres territoires afin de soutenir la mission de l’OCRI et de renforcer les activités d’enquête et de renseignement.


Aptitudes et compétences clés

Éléments essentiels


Diplôme d’études postsecondaires en criminologie, en finance, en affaires ou en comptabilité
Compétences ou expérience en matière d’enquêtes fondées sur le renseignement de sources ouvertes
De 3 à 5 années d’expérience dans le secteur du placement à travailler avec des données
Grande maîtrise de l’ensemble des fonctionnalités de Microsoft 365
Connaissance des outils de visualisation de données comme Microsoft Power BI et i2
Bon jugement dans l’évaluation de la pertinence, de l’utilité et de l’importance de l’information Grand souci du détail et souci de fournir de l’information qui peut être utilisée dans une audience contestée
Aptitudes pour la gestion et la coordination de projets
Expérience des logiciels de base de données et expérience en saisie de données
Esprit d’équipe et excellente aptitude pour la communication orale et écrite


Atouts


Expérience dans les secteurs de la réglementation, de l’application de la loi, de la comptabilité ou de la finance
Connaissance pratique des stratégies de négociation des participants et de leurs clients
Capacité à communiquer en français et en anglais

Prime de rendement *

L’OCRI, qui possède des bureaux dans plusieurs villes au Canada (de Vancouver à Montréal), a pour mission de favoriser des marchés financiers sains en faisant respecter une réglementation équitable et efficace afin que les investisseurs soient protégés et se sentent en confiance lorsqu’ils investissent pour leur avenir. Title: EA Sports FC Player Experience Analyst - FC Quality Verification
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

FC Live Platform Quality Verification is searching for the next game product expert to drive critical activities that support creating an optimal player experience and will be a key point of contact for decision-making from our stakeholders across production and development teams. The EA Sports FC Player Experience Analyst will report to the Development Manager.

This is a hybrid role, working at least 3 days a week in our Burnaby office.

Responsibilities


Create data-driven insights, reports and presentations to showcase trends and players' sentiment
Help promote game and experiential quality across FC by applying “the voice of the player"
Be an advocate of “the voice of the player” by creating a bridge between FC Live Platform Quality Verification and our partners
Promote improvements across functional quality; with a main focus on experiential quality
Monitor internal communication channels, public discussion forums, and social media platforms to help identify player-affecting issues and collect players' feedback
Coordinate with Production to prioritize recurring player feedback effectively


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience in Quality Assurance
4+ years of experience with testing and defect tracking software, preferably Jira
4+ years of experience with Agile/Scrum software development methodologies
Synthesize community feedback and player sentiment into clear, relevant insights that can be discussed with producers and Live Operations partners to improve the player experience
2+ years of experience writing reports and providing updates to stakeholders
Knowledge of gaming consoles and their systems
Experience using collaboration tools, preferably Confluence, Miro, and Slack
Experience working across different time zones and international teams
Understanding of football tactics and in-game strategies.
A genuine love for football as a fan, player, referee, gamer, or coach.
Please include a cover letter to let us know your love/knowledge of the FC game or football (soccer) as a sport.


Learn more about QD from some of our team members at Electronic Arts: Ravi Minhas | Jessica Myk | Rob Weber | Barbara Homewood

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$77,700 - $107,900 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Load Forecast Advisor
Description:
Job Location: Vancouver, BC

Employment type: Permanent

Hours of work: Full-time (37.5 hrs/week)

Annual Salary: $ 109,680 -$138,720

No. of positions: 1

Closing date: October 9th, 2026




What you'll do




The load forecast is a critical foundation of BC Hydro’s Integrated Resource Plan and is used across the company for capital planning, operations planning, revenue forecasting, and other functions. As a Load Forecast Advisor or Senior Load Forecast Advisor in the Industrial Load Forecast team, you will be responsible for producing energy and peak demand forecasts for BC Hydro’s industrial customers as a key member of a broader energy planning group. You will be expected to produce load forecasts using well-established modelling methods, and to develop new modelling methods to forecast emerging loads and sectors.




This position is open to either an Intermediate or Senior level candidate, with future progression within the role possible. Once a selection is made the team will determine which level to offer based on selected candidates’ education, experience and skill set.




The Annual Salary range would be reflected below:




* Load Forecast Advisor (Intermediate): $89,910 - $113,720

* Sr. Load Forecast Advisor: $109,700.00 - $138,700.00

* Utilizes economic models and relationships in delivering industrial load forecasts.




* Proactively identifies emerging drivers—including load, economic, customer, and end-use factors—that may impact future industrial demand.

• Understands industrial customers’ expansion, electrification, and decarbonization roadmaps.

• Translates policy and regulatory changes into long-term load forecasting scenarios.




* Coordinates the efforts of consultants, data providers and department peers where necessary to facilitate the creation of the industrial sector forecasts. Advises the manager on budget requirements.




* Regularly monitors performance of existing forecasting models and processes. Monitor industry developments with respect to models and forecasting methodologies.




* Proactively builds, maintains and manages ongoing internal and external working relationships.

• 2-5 years of relevant work experience, with some experience in the conduct of load research or economic studies.

• Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships and manage stakeholder expectations.




Preferences:




Any combination of the following would be considered an asset:




• Understanding of how energy is used today, and how that use might change in future, for one or more of BC Hydro’s major customer groups (heavy industry including natural gas production, processing and transport; mining; forestry; datacenters)




• Certified Energy Manager designation

- A comprehensive benefits package

- A minimum of 15 paid vacation days

- A lifetime pension

- Flexible work model, depending on your role type

Title: Senior Associate, New Verticals - Canada Strategy & Operations
Description:
About the Team

New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores across the US and Canada. This team focuses on building our Canadian marketplace to ensure we are able to deliver exactly what consumers are looking for when they want it, with speed and quality.

About the Role

We are hiring a few Senior Associates on our Canada New Verticals Strategy & Operations. One role will focus on improving how we partner with our Dashers and driving efficiencies to how they operate. The second role will focus on driving quality improvements to our platform that enhances the shopping experience resulting in higher consumer spend. Both roles will require you to understand marketplace data and constraints to strategize actionable plans to improve efficiency levers impacting things like in-store navigation, in-app experience, dasher pay, pricing & promotions and so much more! These roles require you to understand our three-sided marketplace and the unit economics that impact our financial success all while balancing growth, cost and quality. You'll need to weigh both sides of that tradeoff in every lever you pull.

These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

You will report into a Manager on our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team and be an individual contributor position. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together. We have two positions so throughout the interview process, we will consider you for two roles and align on role fit throughout the interview process!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Strategize. From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.
Operate. Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
Experiment. Design, launch, and share out operational experiments and product features that impact things like dynamic delivery windows, order batching, predictive ordering, in-app merchandising, etc.
Analyze. Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
Build with AI. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
Lead, collaborate and Influence. You'll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product, analytics and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.
Own. You will manage core metrics across Dashers or Consumers and be the DRI for the success of metrics ranging from acceptance rates, batch rates, subtotals, basket size and so many others!
Partner. Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and our US Logistics counterparts to share learnings and scale what works.


We're excited about you because…


You solve problems from first principles. You resist "this is how it's always been done" thinking.
You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
You are an operator. You solve problems by actually understanding the problem.
You like data, and you let it win arguments. You're comfortable building complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and have experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools.
You're energized by AI tools — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you're already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.
You're unafraid of uncharted territory. This role is still taking shape, and you're excited to help define it rather than inherit a fixed playbook.
You have 2-4+ years of experience. You've succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience).
You have a completed Bachelor's Degree.


Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.

$97,000—$121,000 CAD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Title: GIS Analyst
Description:
We are currently seeking candidates for the position of GIS Analyst in our Vancouver Office . You will be a member of Dillon’s GIS Discipline within the Data Integration Services Practice You will be a key part of our multidisciplinary group serving our public sector (federal, provincial, and municipal), and Indigenous clients.

This is a new position and can be based at any one of our Vancouver office. We offer flexible work hours options to help balance the competing demands of work and personal life.

About Dillon

Dillon Consulting Limited (Dillon) is a proudly Canadian, 100% employee-owned professional consulting firm specializing in planning, engineering, environmental science, and management. With over 25 offices and more than 1100 employees across Canada, we offer a wide range of services related to building and improving facilities and infrastructure, protecting the environment, and developing communities.

At Dillon, we strive to remain at the forefront of technology and innovation and thrive on interdisciplinary collaboration, empowering our people to challenge conventional thinking and build careers focused on creating a lasting impact in our communities. We are committed to ongoing professional development and celebrate the unique perspectives that each team member brings to the table.

Employee ownership is available to all Dillon team members, and over 60% of our employees own shares in Dillon. Through employee ownership, we return the financial benefit created by our project work to the very people who created that value. Because we are an employee-owned firm, your voice will be an essential part of our shared success.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams including planners, engineers, scientists, and technologists
Contribute to the development and management of existing and innovative technical systems, standards, and procedures to maintain a high standard of efficiency and quality in products and services
Provide GIS technical support related to GIS components of operational projects (internal and external) including data management, spatial analysis, and visualizations in various GIS and data management software (e.g. ArcGIS, Tableau, and Power BI)
Provide innovative and efficient web tool architecture and design that can be used across multidisciplinary areas
Apply programming and coding skills to assist with project and data resolution management, enhance web applications through the development of additional functionalities and components, and develop automated reporting tools
Develop, implement, and maintain related coding procedures and policies specific to GIS Web Applications throughout the development life cycle, ensuring adherence to organization standards and user requirements. (e.g. ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online)
Test, review, analyze, optimize, and monitor Web GIS Portal systems/tools and internal processes for enhanced efficiency, effectiveness, and to uphold optimal functionality and performance
Conduct comprehensive research and assess a range of GIS software solutions to enhance the development and management of existing and innovative technical systems, tools, and applications



Learning and Development

Commit to self-development and ongoing learning and professional development
Contribute to Dillon’s corporate profile through active participation in professional associations and committees



Qualifications

A degree in Computer Science, Geography, Surveying, Science, Engineering, or a related field
Completion of a one-year technical program in GIS
A minimum of 1-3 years of professional experience, preferably in the consulting industry, or technical program equivalent
Demonstrated abilities in the use of ESRI GIS software (ArcMap, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online)
Report writing, organization, and interpersonal skills
Versatile, adaptable, and willing to conduct a variety of tasks



Experience

Proficient in data compilation, relational database design, and extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes
Designing custom data collection tools and models with automated reports
Using statistics and machine learning principles to manipulate data and present results from large datasets
Understanding of spatial analysis, spatial statistics, remote sensing, and working knowledge of ESRI analysis tools (Network Analyst, Spatial Analyst, 3D Analyst)
Development of mobile applications (Survey123, Collector, Field Maps) and ArcGIS Online web applications
Demonstrated abilities in multidisciplinary project teamwork and coordination
Proficient in the writing of technical reports
Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication, and organizational skills
Working knowledge of the following programs and programming languages would be considered an asset: AutoCAD, Pix4D, Power BI, CityEngine, Python, ArcPy, JavaScript, and Arcade



Young professionals with less than three years of consulting experience have an opportunity to join Dillon Early Career Development (ECD) . Our ECD program is a unique component of our overall Talent Pipeline, designed to accelerate the development of our early career professionals as consultants. Program participants are offered enhanced opportunities for learning and development while building a sense of community through both formal and informal learning.

Dillon’s commitment to the growth and development of our people is a driving force of our success. With over a third of our staff participating in this program, our young professionals are provided with a unique opportunity to practice self-development and build for Dillon’s future.

Compensation

$52,400-$78,800

At Dillon, we believe in transparency. The following salary range is what we expect to offer for this position. It will be dependent on the successful applicant’s education, experience, and skills, in addition to internal equity and geographic region. Dillon reserves the right to pay outside of the posted range, contingent on factors unrelated to an applicant’s gender or other status protected by provincial and/or federal law.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Dillon offers:

Flexible work hours and hybrid work arrangement options to help balance the competing demands of work and personal life
Employee share purchase plan

Dillon is 100% employee-owned, and share ownership is open to all employees. Our annual share dividends have historically outperformed the market average.
Dillon’s Overtime Directive

This Management Directive establishes a firm-wide 40-hour weekly overtime threshold, after which premium pay applies, ensuring consistent and fair compensation across all Canadian offices.
Competitive benefits package, including:

Comprehensive health benefits
Generous retirement savings plan with employer matching up to 5.5%
Student loan repayment assistance
Wellness allowance and enhanced mental health benefits
Ample paid vacation
Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP)
Goodlife Fitness Corporate Membership rates
Early Career Development (ECD) program

At Dillon, we build careers. Designed for technical professionals with less than three years of consulting experience, the ECD program accelerates the transition into entrepreneurial consultants through monthly ‘Level Up’ sessions that build both technical and consulting capabilities. Own your success; we provide the blueprint.


Health & Safety at Dillon
Prospective employees are expected to fully align with Dillon's core commitment to Health & Safety. This includes active, ongoing engagement with our Health & Safety processes and platform, and the active, ongoing identification and reporting of health and safety hazards.

Employment Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Dillon
Dillon is committed to employment equity and an inclusive, diverse workplace where opportunities are based on skills and abilities. If you require accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

Technology enablement and the use of AI at Dillon
Please be advised that Dillon uses AI-assisted tools to support aspects of our recruitment process to increase efficiency and fairness. While AI supports the process, all hiring decisions are made by our human recruiting team. By applying, you acknowledge and consent to this use.

Title: Senior Research Analyst
Description:
Commercial Real Estate + Technology

Floorspace is a modern commercial real estate brokerage and technology company, building tools that make brokers faster, smarter, and more efficient. We pair a high-performing brokerage team with our proprietary platform, FLO, to redefine how deals get done.




We’re growing quickly—and we’re looking for a Senior Research Analyst who can level up our data, insights, and market intelligence.




About the Opportunity

As a Senior Research Analyst at Floorspace, you’ll be a core part of our research engine—responsible for leading our market data program, building high-quality insight products, and supporting brokers with the information they need to win business and advise clients.

This role goes beyond standard research: you’ll help shape how Floorspace collects, structures, and leverages data across Vancouver’s commercial real estate market. You’ll oversee data integrity across FLO, guide junior analysts, and collaborate closely with both our brokerage and product teams.




What You’ll Be Doing

Market Intelligence & Reporting

Lead quarterly and monthly market research for office, industrial, and retail sectors.
Produce data-driven reports, dashboards, and insights for clients, pitches, and internal visibility.
Monitor leasing activity, construction, subleases, and key market trends across Metro Vancouver.

Data Quality & System Ownership

Oversee and maintain the accuracy of core datasets within FLO (buildings, availabilities, leases, comps).
Establish and refine data standards for research across asset classes.
Improve research workflows and help drive automation and efficiency.

Business Development Support

Prepare insight packages for pitch decks and client proposals.
Identify opportunities in the market for tenant rep outreach, landlord listings, and strategic positioning.
Work closely with senior brokers to frame market narratives and support deal execution with data.

Leadership & Collaboration

Mentor and support junior analysts and interns.
Work cross-functionally with marketing to elevate our market storytelling.
Partner with our product and engineering teams to shape future FLO features that rely on research data.

Special Projects

Lead deep-dive studies (sublease trends, sector-specific analyses, demand patterns, etc.).
Contribute to new research formats such as our “Floorspace Five,” neighbourhood guides, and property analyses.




Who We’re Looking For

You’re not just comfortable with data-you know how to use it to tell a compelling story. You bring strong analytical grounding, an understanding of commercial real estate, and the ability to translate information into actionable insights.

You have:

3–5+ years of experience in commercial real estate research, valuation, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of CRE fundamentals—leasing, market dynamics, submarkets, and asset types.
Advanced proficiency in Excel.
Experience managing datasets and ensuring data integrity.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, especially in synthesizing complex information.
Interest in working closely with both brokerage and product/tech teams.
A proactive, organized, and detail-oriented working style.




Why Join Floorspace?

A tech-enabled brokerage model:

You’ll work within a company where research actually matters - our proprietary tech (FLO) relies heavily on your work and insight.

A collaborative, entrepreneurial team:

Work directly with brokers, marketing, product managers, analysts, and leadership. Ideas are encouraged, and execution is fast.

High-impact role:

Your work will shape our market presence, influence client strategy, and power our internal platform.




Working Conditions

Our head office is located in downtown Vancouver. The team is primarily office-based, with some flexibility for hybrid work.




Compensation

Salary range: $70,000–$90,000, depending on experience.

Includes a performance-based bonus program.




Make an Impact

If you’re energized by data, passionate about real estate, and eager to play a meaningful role in the growth of a modern brokerage, we’d love to hear from you.




Floorspace values diversity and is committed to Employment Equity. Direct applicants only-no agencies. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 

Learn more about us at www.floorspace.ca

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
🎨 OpusClip is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 20 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more.

Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024.

Headquartered In Mountain View, We Are a Team Of 100 Passionate And Experienced AI Enthusiasts And Video Experts, Driven By Our Core Values


Be a Champion Team
Prioritize Ruthlessly
Ship fast, Quality Follows
Obsess over customers


Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

About The Role

OpusClip is looking for a product-oriented Data Scientist to help us build trusted metrics, improve data quality, and turn complex product and customer data into clear business decisions.

In this role, you will own critical definitions across feature adoption, weekly active usage, credit consumption, user segmentation, retention, and lifetime value. You will validate reporting data against its source, investigate data-quality issues, and lead analyses that help Product, Finance, and AI teams understand what is working, what is not, and where we should invest next.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable writing SQL, investigating unexpected data, defining metrics with stakeholders, and communicating a clear recommendation.

What You’ll Do

Strengthen data quality and metric governance


Validate reporting tables and dashboards against their source data.
Establish clear definitions, assumptions, sources, and owners for important metrics.
Develop monitoring for duplicate events, unexpected volume spikes, null values, stale data, and reporting discrepancies.
Investigate tracking and data-quality issues across product events and downstream reporting tables.
Help teams distinguish genuine changes in user behavior from instrumentation or pipeline problems.


Lead product and business analysis


Conduct post-launch analyses for major product features and workflows.
Analyze adoption, activation, funnels, retention, segmentation, and user behavior.
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical plans.
Turn findings into actionable recommendations for product and business stakeholders.
Support our data analyst with complex or high-priority analytical requests.


Support retention, LTV, and Finance analytics


Analyze subscriber retention, monetization, and customer lifetime value.
Compare user and revenue behavior across plans, segments, and payment platforms.
Partner with Finance to validate reporting logic and investigate discrepancies.
Communicate assumptions and data limitations clearly when working with financial and payment-related data.


Partner with our AI teams


Support data curation, measurement design, and evaluation for AI-powered product experiences.
Define offline and online success metrics for model-driven features.
Analyze model quality, user behavior, and post-launch business impact.
Partner on experimentation, segmentation, and ongoing performance monitoring.


What We’re Looking For


Typically 3+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, decision science, or a closely related field—or equivalent experience owning work at this level.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, event-level analysis, cohort analysis, and query debugging.
Strong Python skills for analysis, automation, validation, and statistical work.
Experience analyzing product usage, feature adoption, funnels, retention, segmentation, or monetization.
Experience defining and governing metrics, rather than only using existing definitions.
Strong data-validation instincts, including checking joins, duplication, nulls, freshness, source consistency, and tracking changes.
Experience working with event data from Mixpanel, or a similar product analytics platform.
Experience building or maintaining dashboards using tools such as Superset, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
Working knowledge of experimentation, statistical inference, and the limits of causal conclusions.
Strong ownership and the ability to make progress when requirements are ambiguous.
Clear communication skills and experience partnering with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Nice to Have


Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse.
Experience in a product-led SaaS, subscription, consumer software, creator-economy, or AI product company.
Experience analyzing subscription payments, retention, revenue, or LTV.
Familiarity with Stripe, Apple, Google Play, PIX, or other payment-platform data.
Experience with automated data-quality monitoring or anomaly detection.
Experience partnering with ML or AI teams on model evaluation, data curation, or online experiments.
Familiarity with semantic layers, metric stores, or governed self-service analytics.
Exposure to orchestration and transformation tools such as Prefect, Airflow, or dbt.
Awareness of data governance, PII protection, and column-level access controls.
Experience using AI tools to accelerate analytical work while independently validating the output.


What Success Looks Like

Within Your First Six Months, You Will Have


Established trusted definitions for our priority product and business metrics.
Restored or improved reporting for feature adoption, WAU, and credit consumption.
Validated critical reporting tables against their source data.
Introduced proactive monitoring for high-impact data-quality issues.
Delivered product analyses that directly informed roadmap, launch, or experimentation decisions.
Improved the reliability and turnaround time of analytical support for Product, Finance, and other teams.
Become a trusted analytical partner who can move from an ambiguous question to a clear, evidence-based recommendation.


Why Join Us


Own metrics and analyses that directly influence product and business decisions.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, CX, and AI teams.
Help shape the analytical foundation of a fast-growing AI product.
Work with a modern data stack that includes BigQuery, Mixpanel, Superset, Python, Prefect, and Statsig.

In this role, you will own critical definitions across feature adoption, weekly active usage, credit consumption, user segmentation, retention, and lifetime value. You will validate reporting data against its source, investigate data-quality issues, and lead analyses that help Product, Finance, and AI teams understand what is working, what is not, and where we should invest next.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable writing SQL, investigating unexpected data, defining metrics with stakeholders, and communicating a clear recommendation.

Strengthen data quality and metric governance

Title: Senior Analyst, Fulfillment Inventory Management
Description:
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of inventory, analytics, supply chain and strategy, with significant visibility across the organization. You will build models and turn complex data into actionable insights, identify risks and opportunities, and help drive meaningful business results.

The ideal person is a self-starter and strong program manager who can bring clarity to complex, cross-functional initiatives, build alignment across teams, and turn strategy into execution. A consulting background combined with strong retail or supply chain experience would be particularly relevant. There is also a strong continuous-improvement mandate - this is someone who will challenge how things are done and find better ways to drive results.

This is a contract through January 2028.




Who – The Company:

Our client is one of Vancouvers most sought-after companies to work for, with global operations and an impeccable reputation.




What- The Role:

The Fulfillment Inventory Management team plays a critical role in maintaining inventory health, optimizing network capacity, enabling strategic inventory placement across the NAM fulfillment network, and ensuring the timely exit of end‑of‑life inventory. They partner closely with a broad range of cross‑functional teams to deliver on investment commitments while governing the processes that support effective inventory management and end‑of‑life execution.

They design and evolve core operational processes, lead governance routines, strengthen organizational connectivity, and generate data‑driven insights that fuel continuous improvement and risk mitigation. Through consistent and scalable governance frameworks, we drive efficient, standardized inventory practices that improve product availability, maximize DC space utilization, and minimize impacts on DC operations.

This role will lead a team to deliver on key mandates and financial commitments in a highly cross-functional area.

Lead and influence cross‑functional forums (analyst through director level) to enhance collaboration and partnership in support of shared operational, financial, and strategic outcomes.
Build complex operational–financial models that quantify process impacts, identify key drivers and KPIs, evaluate scenarios, surface risks, and recommend actionable improvements.
Partner across the network to improve inventory health, accelerate end‑of‑life inventory turnover, and optimize DC space utilization and overall operational efficiency.
Drive cross‑functional KPI improvements (e.g. inventory health, capacity, labor efficiency) by leading root cause analysis, quantifying possible levers to improve, and enabling teams with the right data, tools, and governance routines to support strategic prioritization and accountable execution.
Analyze large, complex datasets (Excel, Power BI, and related tools) to generate timely, accurate insights to support operational and financial decisions.
Support a multi-million dollar savings portfolio by creating and enabling processes and tactical execution plans, leveraging strong cross-team communication and influencing skills to proactively identify risks and develop initial risk mitigation strategies.
Support existing processes and enable new optimizations by creating integrated tools that provide transparent KPI visibility and faster, more effective issue escalation and resolution.
Continuously optimize current-state fulfillment processes to improve accuracy, speed, and alignment with evolving business priorities and strategic direction.




Who- the Candidate:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Supply chain or similar; Analytics is an asset; MBA or CPA preferred
5-8 years of experience, preferably in consulting, strategy or equivalent experience with product/supply chain internal function within a large corporation
4+ years of experience working within a highly cross-functional team
Proven ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects with varying timelines and scopes; including ability to plan, budget and manage project execution
Self-starter approach to work, with an eagerness to consistently meet and exceed objectives and foster this within your team
Excellent attention to detail given the complex nature of the work and the high exposure of the content across various groups and leadership
Creative thinking and excellent problem-solving skills – must be able to solve problems in a new way, seeing past what is established and create a new way of doing things
Demonstrated ability to create clarity and drive alignment towards a common goal and across team members in various functions
Advanced proficiency with MS PowerPoint, Excel, Word necessary. Experience using Power BI is an asset
Strong process documentation skills and excellent spoken and written communication skills (verbal and non-verbal)




How much:

Competitive hourly wage in the range of $55-57.50/hr + 4% vacation pay, if incorporated, please discuss with Swim.




Where:

Vancouver, hybrid working conditions, minimum 3 days onsite.




When & How To Apply:

Swim Recruiting has been engaged as a trusted recruitment agency partner on this important search. If you already have a Recruiter at SWIM, please reach out very soon. If you do not yet have a contact at Swim Recruiting, please hit 'APPLY NOW' to send us your resume. Thank you!

Position Title: Data Platform Analyst

Position Status: Full-Time Regular

Department: Corporate Services

Employee Group: Teamsters Local 31

Location: 4515 Central Boulevard, Burnaby

Salary Range/ Wage Rate: PG T27 $3,734.48 - $4,413.08 bi-weekly




Our Corporate Services Department is seeking a Data Platform Analyst who will support and maintain enterprise data platforms, database systems, and analytics solutions. You will develop and optimize data pipelines, data models, and reporting solutions; administer and monitor database environments; troubleshoot operational issues; and liaise between client departments, technical staff, and vendors to keep data systems reliable, secure, and aligned to business needs.




You are a pragmatic, service-oriented data professional with strong technical depth across database administration, data engineering, and analytics, who can translate business requirements into well-governed, supportable data solutions and keep critical enterprise data platforms running dependably.




This role:

Installs and maintains database systems to ensure a high level of data availability; develops database architecture using established standards; maintains and ensures database and coding standards and quality assurance standards and procedures; assists with planning and coordinating data migration between systems; and assists with the development and maintenance of cloud database components.
Develops and maintains ETL (extract, transform, load) processes and data pipelines for data integration across platforms; designs and develops data models for data warehousing and business analytics; assists with data integration and transformation between data sources; supports data warehouse development and maintenance; and monitors and validates data flows to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Develops, implements and maintains data analytics solutions using enterprise business intelligence tools; works with business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate, and deliver data analytics solutions; creates and optimizes semantic data models, calculated measures, and data transformations for solutions; and provides training and assistance to business users on self-service analytic tools.
Monitors and evaluates technical performance of corporate data systems; identifies and resolves data abnormalities to avoid system outages; recommends replacement of aging systems and opportunities for optimization; assists with the monitoring and administration of cloud data storage solutions; provides technical support for operational issues; and participates in data backup and recovery planning.
Serves as a technical resource on various infrastructure and database projects; completes tasks according to project schedules; coordinates with departmental stakeholders to ensure that database standards remain relevant and aligned with business requirements; as required, oversees the work of consultants for compliance with corporate database and applications development standards.
Researches, evaluates and recommends information technology solutions and best practices related to data engineering, analytics, and data management; evaluates impacts of new technology and practices on existing systems; and prepares and presents related reports as required.
Maintains documentation for database configurations, data pipelines, reports and procedures.
Performs related work as required.




To be successful, you have:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, data engineering, business analytics or related discipline, plus considerable related experience in data analytics, data engineering and database administration; or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
Considerable knowledge of relational database management systems, including the principles, methods, practices and procedures for database administration, maintenance, design and optimization.
Considerable knowledge of data engineering methods and procedures, including the tools and practices for extracting, transforming, loading data, automating and optimizing data pipelines for data integration.
Considerable knowledge of data analytic methods and procedures, including statistical analysis, data visualization and modeling techniques, processes and tools related to the work.
Considerable knowledge of the characteristics and capabilities of the District’s computing environment.
Considerable knowledge of problem definition and solution techniques applicable to the work.
Sound knowledge of the functions of departments served and their requirements as applied to the work.
Ability to analyze and evaluate various data and information requirements and to prepare data engineering and data analytics solutions to meet the needs of client departments.
Ability to develop databases including physical and logical data structures, using established standards.
Ability to evaluate and monitor the performance of databases and related applications to ensure data integrity, security and optimization of database resources, and to provide related technical support.
Ability to design and implement data transformation logic and pipeline workflows for data integration.
Ability to create and optimize data models, processes, queries, and calculated measures.
Ability to serve as a technical resource for enterprise infrastructure and database projects.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with a variety of contacts, to communicate effectively, and to provide advice and assistance on matters related to the work.
Skill in using SQL, common programming languages, and enterprise business intelligence tools.
Driver’s Licence for the Province of British Columbia.

Title: Sales Operations Analyst
Description:
About Earthdaily

EarthDaily is revolutionizing the way we understand and monitor our planet. Through cutting-edge Earth Observation (EO) technology and geospatial analytics, we provide unparalleled insights for industries ranging from agriculture to mining, insurance, and government intelligence. Our mission is to build the world’s most advanced change detection system to capture, analyze, and interpret global shifts in near real-time.

OUR CREW

Our global, distributed team represents a variety of business lines and is made up of business development, sales, marketing and support professionals, data scientists, software engineers, project managers and finance, HR, and IT professionals. We are currently looking for a detail-oriented, Vancouver-based Sales Operations Analyst to join our crew!

READY TO LAUNCH?

Do you want to join one of the most exciting space companies at the forefront of global change detection/change monitoring? At EarthDaily, the Sales Operations Analyst is responsible for the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of our CRM and sales data across multiple lines of business and market verticals. This is a full-time, hybrid position based at our Vancouver Convention Centre office. Occasional travel may be required.

PREPARE FOR IMPACT!

As a Sales Operations Analyst, you will partner with the Sales Operations and Finance teams to identify, investigate, and resolve data quality issues, establish and enforce data entry standards, and maintain the governance processes that keep records consistent as the business scales.

As a detail-oriented problem solver with a systems mindset, you will leverage CRM tooling, reporting platforms, and all available processes to surface anomalies before they reach downstream reporting. You’ll take a proactive approach to data stewardship, routinely auditing records rather than waiting for errors to surface and translating recurring issues into durable process and system improvements. As a trusted resource to the sales and finance teams, you will ensure that account, opportunity, and pipeline data can be relied upon for forecasting, commission calculation, and executive decision-making.

Data Quality and Cleanup


Review and audit CRM records (contacts, accounts, opportunities, leads) for accuracy, completeness, and duplicates
Identify and correct data entry errors, missing fields, and inconsistent formatting in the CRM
Lead or support data cleanup projects such as deduplication, record merging, and standardizing naming conventions
Manage the import and validation of new leads or account data from third-party sources


Standards, Governance and Training


Establish and maintain data entry guidelines, and train and support sales reps on proper data entry practices
Maintain data definitions and a data dictionary for standard fields used across the sales team
Recommend process improvements to reduce recurring data quality issues
Escalate or collaborate with senior Sales Operations, Finance, and/or Data Governance staff on complex or cross-system data issues


Reporting and Metrics


Build and monitor data quality dashboards and reports, and investigate anomalies and trends
Track and report on data quality metrics (e.g., duplicate rate, field completeness, data decay) and remediation progress to Sales Operations and Finance leadership


Systems, Integrations and Automation


Partner with Sales Ops and IT on integration checks between the CRM and other connected sales tools (e.g., marketing automation, lead enrichment platforms)
Design and build sales automation and AI solutions to increase process efficiency and suggest improvements to the customer experience


YOUR PAST MISSIONS


Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, information systems, data analytics, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
1 to 4 years of experience in sales operations, sales support, data quality, revenue operations, or a related analytical role, with a proven track record of improving the accuracy and reliability of business-critical data
Hands-on experience administering or maintaining a CRM platform, including bulk data operations using data loaders, deduplication tools, or similar utilities
Demonstrated experience cleaning, reconciling, and manipulating large datasets (10,000+ rows) using advanced Excel functions such as INDEX/MATCH, nested IFs, array formulas, data tables, and Power Query
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports in a CRM or BI environment (Salesforce, HubSpot, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Exposure to data governance or data quality frameworks
Experience supporting forecasting, pipeline reporting, or commission processes in a SaaS or technical sales environment
Applied use of AI for analysis or automation


YOUR TOOLKIT


Deep working knowledge of CRM data structures, including the relationships between accounts, contacts, opportunities, and pipeline stages (HubSpot preferred but not required)
Understanding of sales and marketing processes and metrics (prospecting, lead gen, contracts, time to close, ACV/TCV/LCV, CAC/CPL, ROAS/ROMI, etc.)
Understanding of finance and reporting metrics (revenue recognition, backlog and pipeline calculations, close probabilities, growth scenarios, CAGR, etc.)
Has built, or can build, AI tools to automate sales processes (e.g., Claude, HubSpot Breeze)
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and data validation
Basic to intermediate SQL for querying and validating data across systems
Strong attention to detail with a methodical, systematic approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving data issues
Understands the downstream impact of poor data quality on forecasting, reporting, and commission accuracy
Curious and inquisitive, excellent at asking questions to understand why an error occurred rather than only correcting it
Able to work independently on recurring data quality tasks while recognizing when to escalate; highly organized with excellent time management and the ability to balance competing priorities
Strong work ethic and self-drive, with an honest and ethical approach
Team player with a proactive and positive attitude, and experience collaborating with internal and cross-functional teams


Your Compensation

Base Salary Range: $55,000 to $80,000 CAD annually

The range is based on Vancouver, BC-derived compensation for this role. Individual placement in the range is determined based on many factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The top end of the range is typically reserved for individuals that meet or exceed all required qualifications and show demonstrated experience and expertise in all responsibilities of the role.

OUR SPACE

We’d love to welcome you to our world of software for space. We have a shared passion for building production critical systems that generate near real-time views of Earth from satellites that power real-world applications like disaster mitigation, environmental monitoring and crop yield improvements.

This is a full-time, in-office role at our Vancouver Convention Centre office, working in a fast-paced environment with regular collaboration across a team spread over North American time zones, and occasional travel (approximately 10%).

WHY EARTHDAILY ANALYTICS?


Competitive compensation, full benefits and flexible time off
Be part of a meaningful mission as part of one of Canada’s most innovative space companies that are developing sustainable solutions for our planet
Work from home opportunities (hybrid)
Great work environment, team and one of the best office locations in Vancouver (right over the water in the Vancouver Convention Centre)
Company subsidized lunches, lunch & learns and Friday afternoon social hours

As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Position Overview

You’re a sharp analytical thinker with a knack for leveraging utility planning optimization software tools. Along with your love for quantitative analysis, you’re a numbers guru who excels in forecasting and modelling analyses.

In this role, you will:


Ensure the execution of strategies at the departmental and organizational level, both for analytical and regulatory submissions, that support business priorities.
Strengthen internal modelling expertise and capabilities while strategically guiding and integrating third-party consultant analyses into resource planning activities.
Analyze markets, energy utility planning environment, customer energy use, and provide useful qualitative and comparative insights.
Support workshops between our Gas and Electric utility resource planning analyses and reporting activities.
Collaborate with internal and external cross-functional experts to use energy demand and other business data to support recommendations on planning and project strategies.


What it takes:


A degree in economics, computer science, finance, business administration, or a related resource development field.
A minimum of four years of related analytical experience.
A demonstrated ability to learn coding languages such as R, Python, or other.
Prior experience with optimization models, production cost analytics, and macroeconomic modeling through software such as Plexos, Aurora, Navius, or other energy modelling tools is an asset.
Strong attention to detail and organization skills to conduct accurate analyses and forecasts.
Excellent interpersonal and time management skills to develop and deliver presentations with succinct recommendations and supported strategic arguments.


In this role, you will have the option to participate in a flexible work program, enabling you to work from an approved flex location in British Columbia up to 85 days a year (equivalent to approximately two days a week), subject to business or operational needs.

Our engaging workplace offers a wide range of challenging opportunities, while being safe, inclusive, and diverse. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, while supporting life-long career development. We also encourage volunteerism and nourish the need to give back to your community.
