Title: Compensation Analyst
Description:
We know it is our people who make us great at what we do.




We are looking for a compensation professional to support our growing compensation consulting team on several current and up coming client projects, and other initiatives. We are looking for someone, based in Vancouver or Toronto, with superb analytical and communication skills who is highly motivated, has a fine eye for detail, and can juggle multiple tasks and deliverables.




A typical day-in-the life of a Compensation Analyst involves meeting with clients, performing data analysis, understanding compensation trends to inform clients on compensation-related inquiries, and supporting internal projects. As a team member, you will work in partnership with the project managers to support clients all across Canada and gain exposure to the many areas of compensation practices including salary structure design, market analysis, job documentation and evaluation, executive pay, pay equity, salary surveys and many more!




If you are looking to take your HR and compensation career to the next level, this may be the right role for you!




This posting is for an existing vacancy that we are actively seeking to fill.




Roles and Responsibilities

Utilize Excel and other analysis tools to build compensation-related tools, dashboards, and analysis by adopting advanced techniques to compute and aggregate data, and conduct market comparisons
Interpret data and derive key market insights for clients and other reports
Support consulting team members on client projects by providing high-touch data analysis covering a wide-spread of broad compensation activities, including external market analysis using salary surveys, salary structure design, executive pay, incentive plan design, pay equity, and job evaluation
Conduct market benchmarking by reviewing client data, determining appropriate peer groups, and performing data compilation/aggregation among multiple sources, sectors, and industry databases
Collect, organize, track, and interpret client pay program information and policy material
Support national and custom external market compensation survey activities relating to questionnaire setup, create job capsules, survey tracking, database management, administration, data validation, and client communications
Help clients write job descriptions (JDs) by reviewing existing job documentation, organizational structures, JD templates, and conducting interviews
Support consultants on project management duties, including managing client documentation, coordination, scheduling, meeting note documentation, and general status tracking
Support the job evaluation process by reviewing and creating job descriptions and evaluating roles using a job evaluation methodology
Conduct research and perform financial analyses of industry sectors and client peer groups to understand business strategy, corporate performance, compensation, and rewards practices and trends
Support the team in preparation of client and business development-related presentations and executive reports; translate data into broader total rewards themes and recommendations, utilizing multiple applications including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint




What we offer

Collaborative and engaging atmosphere
Variety in work and ability to evolve and grow your career
Working with colleagues across Canada and across multiple practice areas
Opportunities to help build and evolve our practice
Competitive compensation in terms of salary, bonus and paid vacation time (commensurate with experience)
An entrepreneurial, collegial work environment
Hybrid work style and dress for your day approach

What you offer

0-2 years of relevant experience is preferred but not required. Previous co-op terms, internships, or other related experience will be considered an asset
Bachelor's degree specifically in Business, Commerce, Economics, or a related field (required) with a baseline understanding of the different organization structures
Analytical skills and basic proficiency in MS Excel (comfortable with lookups, pivot tables, and basic formulas) combined with a strong knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and database management
Strong oral and written communication skills including the ability to independently write a strong first draft report or insights presentation for clients
Strong desire to learn and develop through exposure to various projects and clients
Demonstrated ability to follow established standards and procedures
Ability to work in a team environment while managing multiple priorities and projects
Excellent interpersonal skills, strong verbal and written communication skills
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Commitment to superior client satisfaction




Strong assets but not required

Prior co-op/ internship experience in data analysis, consulting, and/or compensation
Previous work experience in compensation with knowledge in market matching and benchmarking, job evaluation, job description writing, pay equity, or executive compensation
In the process of completing or willingness to complete the Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation
Bilingual in both English and French (reading, writing, and speaking)




Who we are:

At Eckler, we are driven by our purpose to care and to do right by people so that together we can achieve a brighter, more secure future. It’s just one of the reasons Eckler has been recognized multiple times as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures. Our origins go back to 1927, making us one of Canada’s first actuarial practices. Based in Canada and the Caribbean, we’re a team of committed and highly skilled professionals consulting in the areas of pension, retirement, financial wellness, investment, group benefits, insurance, change management and communication and technology. Owned and operated by its active Principals, the company has earned a reputation for service continuity and high professional standards. Eckler is a founding member of Abelica Global – an international alliance of independent actuarial and consulting firms operating in over 20 countries.




At Eckler, we value diversity of all types. Our organization is made up of smart, collaborative, and thoughtful people with a wide range of backgrounds, skills, and experiences. We are committed to an inclusive, diverse, and accessible workplace and encourage all interested applicants to submit a cover letter and resume for consideration. Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process or those needing job postings in an alternative format may e-mail a request to careers@eckler.ca.




Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used during the recruitment process to screen or assess applications. All evaluations involving AI are reviewed by in-house recruiters prior to making any final decisions.




We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those selected for the short list will be contacted.

In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Workday stands at a pivotal point in its evolution and growth. As we accelerate our Enterprise AI Transformation we must focus with equal intensity on scaling our execution to enable a rapid speed of continuous innovation for our customers. The Product & Technology (P&T) Operations Analytics & Tools Team develops decision-ready internal products that turn complex organizational data into targeted leadership action. Our vision is to: Power the strategic intelligence that scales how P&T operates with alignment and speed.

About The Role

We're looking for a business, product, and customer-oriented Senior Product Data Scientist to be the analytics partner for the Workday Data Cloud business. This role requires focused passion and excitement unlocking data insights that directly tie to strategic execution.

This role sits at the intersection of Workday's Data Cloud business, partnering directly with the Data Cloud organization (SVP/GM, Product Management, Engineering, and GTM teams) to bring analytical rigor and powerful business insights to a fast-growing, consumption-based product line. You will be the investigatory lead on a number of broad business questions. You will dive into the raw business data, find the root cause, and deliver an opinionated, decision-ready conclusion, not just more data.

You'll need to become a genuine subject-matter expert in Workday Data Cloud's business data landscape, working closely with the Workday Data Cloud GM and Product Management team. Your findings, and the curated data and documentation you produce along the way, should compound: feeding a shared knowledge base that makes the next question easier to answer, for you and for AI-assisted tooling built on top of the same body of work.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as the business analytics domain expert for Workday Data Cloud, providing technical and strategic thought leadership.
Partner cross-functionally across Go-To-Market (GTM) and Product teams to develop end-to-end views of the business, connecting the dots between top-of-funnel demand growth, sales pipeline, and downstream product usage.
Translate complex data models into compelling narratives and stories (including interactive visualizations and executive presentations) that drive organizational clarity.
Operate directly with SVP/GM-level stakeholders, translating a stream of layered, high-velocity questions into structured analysis without needing fully scoped requirements up front.
Translate ambiguous business, data, and platform questions into simple and focused conclusions, independently and with strategic judgment
Support consumption-based pricing and impact analysis for Workday Data Cloud, including sensitivity analysis, exploring new business models and driving business growth
Navigate real data-maturity and instrumentation gaps with autonomy: identifying what already exists, what must be built, and when to escalate.
Contribute well-documented, curated data assets and context back into the shared knowledge base so that analysis compounds over time and can eventually be self-served.
Design and influence Workday Data Cloud internal business data connections, collaborating with Product Management and engineering teams on the design, scalability, and sustainability of associated pipelines.
Leverage strong data ETL and data processing expertise to manage multi-step flows across product telemetry and observability systems
Demonstrate urgency and autonomy in problem-solving, proactively navigating cross-functional teams to identify and implement solutions for both known and emerging business challenges.


About You

You possess a deep interest in grasping the complex challenges that businesses face, and you are excited by solving problems. You have strong business acumen and are outcomes focused. Learning new tools and technologies motivates you. You embody the qualities of an insightful, thoughtful, and reliable teammate - and you expect the same of your teammates. You thrive in a fast-paced, tech start-up like environment where the best ideas win. “Think Like a Scientist” is ingrained in how you work - always hypothesizing, always experimenting, always learning.

You're energized, not intimidated, by building trust, process, and domain expertise in a new, growing business space. You default to curating and documenting what you learn, because you know the same data landscape will get harder questions tomorrow. You're comfortable moving between hands-on data work and strategic, executive-level framing.

Basic Qualifications


8+ years of experience with advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and/or data science
8+ years experience simplifying complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.
6-8 years experience working autonomously in a highly matrixed, collaborative corporate environment.
5+ years experience in business/product analytics, applied data science, or a related quantitative role, ideally supporting a product or platform organization.
5+ years experience in enterprise BI platforms (e.g.,Tableau, Sigma)


Other Qualifications:


Strong SQL and data-modeling skills; comfortable working directly in raw, partially documented, or partially instrumented datasets.
Familiarity with front-end components or frameworks (e.g., React, Node.js, JavaScript) to help collaborate with engineering peers.
Working familiarity with cloud data pipelines/ETL concepts (e.g., Airflow) sufficient to partner effectively with data engineering and platform product management teams.
Experience with SaaS pricing analytics or usage-based/consumption pricing models specifically.
Strong project management skills
Experience applying organizational change management principles
Experience working within an Agile/Scrum framework.
Experience within the SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology industries
Strong communication and data storytelling skills
Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise production-level data science-based products for business decision-making
Experience on AWS stack (Redshift, Sagemaker), scripting languages (Python and R)
Degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or a related field) or equivalent practical experience.
Understanding of product management fundamentals

Title: Load Forecast Advisor
Description:
Job Location: Vancouver, BC

Employment type: Permanent

Hours of work: Full-time (37.5 hrs/week)

Annual Salary: $ 109,680 -$138,720

No. of positions: 1

Closing date: October 9th, 2026




What you'll do




The load forecast is a critical foundation of BC Hydro’s Integrated Resource Plan and is used across the company for capital planning, operations planning, revenue forecasting, and other functions. As a Load Forecast Advisor or Senior Load Forecast Advisor in the Industrial Load Forecast team, you will be responsible for producing energy and peak demand forecasts for BC Hydro’s industrial customers as a key member of a broader energy planning group. You will be expected to produce load forecasts using well-established modelling methods, and to develop new modelling methods to forecast emerging loads and sectors.




This position is open to either an Intermediate or Senior level candidate, with future progression within the role possible. Once a selection is made the team will determine which level to offer based on selected candidates’ education, experience and skill set.




The Annual Salary range would be reflected below:




* Load Forecast Advisor (Intermediate): $89,910 - $113,720

* Sr. Load Forecast Advisor: $109,700.00 - $138,700.00




The main responsibilities associated with delivering timely and accurate forecasts include:




* Utilizes economic models and relationships in delivering industrial load forecasts.




* Proactively identifies emerging drivers—including load, economic, customer, and end-use factors—that may impact future industrial demand.

• Understands industrial customers’ expansion, electrification, and decarbonization roadmaps.

• Translates policy and regulatory changes into long-term load forecasting scenarios.




* Coordinates the efforts of consultants, data providers and department peers where necessary to facilitate the creation of the industrial sector forecasts. Advises the manager on budget requirements.




* Regularly monitors performance of existing forecasting models and processes. Monitor industry developments with respect to models and forecasting methodologies.




* Proactively builds, maintains and manages ongoing internal and external working relationships.




Additional Responsibilities for the Senior Load Forecast Advisor:




* Leads complex forecasting studies and establishes the analytical approach and delivery plan for key industrial sub-sectors such as oil and gas, mining, forestry, emerging industries (such as AI, data centers, hydrogen), load and market research programs and customer surveys.




* Provides independent leadership for a larger portfolio of projects than the Load Forecast Advisor, ensuring successful delivery of key business objectives.




* Planning, organizing and implementing the annual work schedule. Coordinating the integration of sector forecasts within regional and system load forecasts and with other critical and complex company processes




* Establishes and ensures new modelling methodologies are appropriate and carries out due diligence over data.




* Leads continuous improvement of forecasting models, methodologies, data practices, and workflows and promotes adoption of improved approaches within the load forecasting team.




* Exercises independent judgment in analysis and problem solving on highly complex and medium scope problems.




What you bring




* Load Forecast Advisor (Intermediate):




• 2-5 years of relevant work experience, with some experience in the conduct of load research or economic studies.




• Good data management and attention to detail.




* OR Senior Load Forecast Advisor:




• A minimum of 6-8 years of relevant experience with demonstrated depth in one or more of the following areas: industrial project development proposals, existing industrial operations analysis, policy analysis, energy industry developments and forecasting, data management and analytics.




• Ability to lead processes independently and drive continuous improvement initiatives.




• Advanced technical leadership skills in forecasting or industrial sector. Understanding of the operational profiles, production cycles, and energy requirements of major industrial sectors




• A master’s degree in a relevant discipline is an asset.




Common Requirements:




• Post-secondary degree in relevant areas such as economics, engineering, business, or other relevant discipline.




• Demonstrated capability of designing and building analytical models and/or conducting industrial sector market research.




• Demonstrated competency with MS Office suite, particularly Excel.




• Demonstrated oral and written communications skills, including the ability to prepare PowerPoint slides, write briefing notes and make presentations for senior leaders.




• Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of multidisciplinary teams comprising consultants and employees.




• Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships and manage stakeholder expectations.




Preferences:




Any combination of the following would be considered an asset:




• Understanding of how energy is used today, and how that use might change in future, for one or more of BC Hydro’s major customer groups (heavy industry including natural gas production, processing and transport; mining; forestry; datacenters)




• Certified Energy Manager designation




What we offer




- A comprehensive benefits package

- A minimum of 15 paid vacation days

- A lifetime pension

- Flexible work model, depending on your role type

- Training and development courses




For more information on the benefits we offer, visit bchydro.com/benefits.




* This is a Hybrid role; however there are times that this role will require in-office attendance at BC Hydro’s downtown Vancouver location, up to five days a week.




How to apply




Interested candidates should submit their applications online at https://app.bchydro.com/careers/current_opp.html or click ‘Apply’




You must use a supported browser, such as Firefox, Internet Explorer, Google Chrome or Safari. Your pop up blocker will also need to be disabled for the BC Hydro Careers site.




On the BC Hydro Careers site, click on the Apply button in order to complete the steps to apply for this job. Please be sure to update your Candidate Profile with your current resume and include copies of your certifications, if applicable.

Title: Senior Associate, New Verticals - Canada Strategy & Operations
Description:
About the Team

New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores across the US and Canada. This team focuses on building our Canadian marketplace to ensure we are able to deliver exactly what consumers are looking for when they want it, with speed and quality.

About the Role

We are hiring a few Senior Associates on our Canada New Verticals Strategy & Operations. One role will focus on improving how we partner with our Dashers and driving efficiencies to how they operate. The second role will focus on driving quality improvements to our platform that enhances the shopping experience resulting in higher consumer spend. Both roles will require you to understand marketplace data and constraints to strategize actionable plans to improve efficiency levers impacting things like in-store navigation, in-app experience, dasher pay, pricing & promotions and so much more! These roles require you to understand our three-sided marketplace and the unit economics that impact our financial success all while balancing growth, cost and quality. You'll need to weigh both sides of that tradeoff in every lever you pull.

These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

Title: Financial Operation Analyst, Revenue & Commissions
Description:
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Reports To: Finance Operation Manager

Location: Vancouver, BC (Hybrid)

Primary Purpose

The Financial Operation Analyst, Revenue & Commissions is responsible for supporting the University's Accounts Receivable, Student Refunds, and Agent Commission operations by ensuring the accurate, timely, and efficient processing of financial transactions, reconciliations, reporting, and operational analysis. The role serves as the primary operational support to the Commissions and Accounts Receivable function, coordinating day-to-day activities across revenue operations and helping ensure service standards, internal controls, and operational objectives are consistently achieved.

The Financial Operation Analyst partners closely with Business Development, Registrar, Admissions, Student Services, Academic Operations, and external recruitment agents to resolve operational issues, improve business processes, and enhance the student and agent experience. The role contributes to financial integrity through reconciliations, reporting, compliance, and data analysis while identifying opportunities for automation, process optimization, and continuous improvement across Accounts Receivable, Student Refunds, and Agent Commission operations.

Specific Responsibilities

Reconciliation, Reporting & Analysis:


Perform monthly reconciliations between student information system, ERP, payment platforms and banking records. Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial records.
Preform commission accrual calculations and reconciliations. Prepare month-end supporting schedules and working papers.
Prepare commission, accounts receivable, collection, and revenue performance reports.
Analyze trends related to revenue, scholarship, commissions, refunds, bad debt, and student payment activity
Forecast commissions, refunds and collections
Develop and maintain recurring financial reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using Power BI, Python and other reporting tools.
Identify risks, exceptions, and operational issues and recommend corrective actions.


Revenue Operations


Manage daily accounts receivable activities, including the processing, recording, and reconciliation of student payments received through various payment channels, ensuring accuracy and timely posting within financial and student information systems.
Monitor student account balances, aging reports, unapplied payments, chargebacks, and outstanding receivables, proactively identifying issues and supporting collection efforts to optimize cash flow and minimize bad debt.
Administer student financial transactions, including deposits, tuition payments, refunds, credits, installment plans, scholarship, fee adjustments, and collection agency transactions, ensuring compliance with university policies and procedures.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve the student and agent experience through efficient financial operations.


Agent Commission Operation


Calculate agent commissions in accordance with contractual agreements, institutional policies, and established timelines.
Review commission invoices, supporting documentation, and payment eligibility requirements to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Validate commission calculations and investigate discrepancies, exceptions, and payment variances.
Reconcile commission payments against contracts, student records, and financial systems.
Maintain agent contract databases, commission records, and supporting documentation to ensure completeness and audit readiness.
Support agent inquiries related to commission payments, calculations, and contract terms.


Student Refund Operation


Coordinate the end-to-end student refund process, ensuring refund requests are processed accurately, timely, and in accordance with university policies and service standards.
Review refund requests for completeness and eligibility, validating supporting documentation, tuition adjustments, administrative charges, and payment requirements.
Prepare and process refund transactions through banking platforms, Flywire, and other payment channels while maintaining appropriate documentation and audit trails.
Maintain refund tracking logs and monitor refund aging to ensure timely resolution of outstanding and pending cases.
Reconcile refund transactions between the Student Information System, ERP, banking records, and payment platforms, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
Prepare refund reports, reconciliations, and operational metrics to support management reporting and continuous process improvement.
Identify process improvement opportunities that enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and student experience of refund operations.


System Accuracy And Process Improvement


Support implementation, testing, and enhancement of financial systems and related integrations.
Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
Participate in automation initiatives and workflow optimization projects.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and process documentation.
Support data validation, system reconciliations, and operational process reviews.


Audit, Compliance & Internal Controls


Maintain organized supporting documentation to ensure compliance with audit requirements and internal policies.
Assist with internal and external audit requests and information gathering.
Support the execution of internal control procedures across commission and accounts receivable processes.
Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, financial policies, and established procedures.
Participate in fraud prevention, exception monitoring, and risk mitigation activities.
Support continuous improvement of financial controls and operational governance.


Position Requirements

Competencies


Experience with Python is strongly preferred
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reconciliation models, pivot tables, and complex formulas.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills.
Strong understanding of internal controls, audit requirements, fraud prevention, and financial governance.
Ability to analyze operational and financial data, identify trends, measure KPIs, and provide actionable business insights.
Experience with workflow automation, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong understanding of accounting principles, revenue recognition, and month-end close processes related to revenue operations.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to manage competing priorities and meet tight deadlines.
Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial operations, and controls
Ability to analyze financial data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights
Customer-service orientation with the ability to work effectively with internal and external partners.
Demonstrated initiative and a continuous improvement mindset.
High level of accountability, ownership, and initiative, consistently delivering high-quality work with minimal supervision.
Demonstrated leadership potential through mentoring colleagues, coordinating operational activities, and contributing to team success without direct supervisory authority.
Results-oriented with a focus on achieving operational KPIs, service standards, and continuous improvement objectives.


Education and Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
Additional certifications in financial systems, data analytics, or process improvement are an asset
Minimum 3–5 years of progressive experience in finance operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, or commission-based environments
Experience working with large datasets and multiple integrated systems.
Exposure to audit support, internal controls, compliance, or process improvement initiatives is desirable.
Experience working in a fast-paced, customer-focused, and highly collaborative environment.

Conduct comprehensive research and assess a range of GIS software solutions to enhance the development and management of existing and innovative technical systems, tools, and applications

Contribute to Dillon’s corporate profile through active participation in professional associations and committees

Using statistics and machine learning principles to manipulate data and present results from large datasets

We are currently seeking candidates for the position of GIS Analyst in our Vancouver Office . You will be a member of Dillon’s GIS Discipline within the Data Integration Services Practice You will be a key part of our multidisciplinary group serving our public sector (federal, provincial, and municipal), and Indigenous clients.

This is a new position and can be based at any one of our Vancouver office. We offer flexible work hours options to help balance the competing demands of work and personal life.

About Dillon

Dillon Consulting Limited (Dillon) is a proudly Canadian, 100% employee-owned professional consulting firm specializing in planning, engineering, environmental science, and management. With over 25 offices and more than 1100 employees across Canada, we offer a wide range of services related to building and improving facilities and infrastructure, protecting the environment, and developing communities.

At Dillon, we strive to remain at the forefront of technology and innovation and thrive on interdisciplinary collaboration, empowering our people to challenge conventional thinking and build careers focused on creating a lasting impact in our communities. We are committed to ongoing professional development and celebrate the unique perspectives that each team member brings to the table.

Employee ownership is available to all Dillon team members, and over 60% of our employees own shares in Dillon. Through employee ownership, we return the financial benefit created by our project work to the very people who created that value. Because we are an employee-owned firm, your voice will be an essential part of our shared success.

Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams including planners, engineers, scientists, and technologists
  • Contribute to the development and management of existing and innovative technical systems, standards, and procedures to maintain a high standard of efficiency and quality in products and services
  • Provide GIS technical support related to GIS components of operational projects (internal and external) including data management, spatial analysis, and visualizations in various GIS and data management software (e.g. ArcGIS, Tableau, and Power BI)
  • Provide innovative and efficient web tool architecture and design that can be used across multidisciplinary areas
  • Apply programming and coding skills to assist with project and data resolution management, enhance web applications through the development of additional functionalities and components, and develop automated reporting tools
  • Develop, implement, and maintain related coding procedures and policies specific to GIS Web Applications throughout the development life cycle, ensuring adherence to organization standards and user requirements. (e.g. ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online)
  • Test, review, analyze, optimize, and monitor Web GIS Portal systems/tools and internal processes for enhanced efficiency, effectiveness, and to uphold optimal functionality and performance
  • Conduct comprehensive research and assess a range of GIS software solutions to enhance the development and management of existing and innovative technical systems, tools, and applications


Learning and Development
  • Commit to self-development and ongoing learning and professional development
  • Contribute to Dillon’s corporate profile through active participation in professional associations and committees


Qualifications
  • A degree in Computer Science, Geography, Surveying, Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Completion of a one-year technical program in GIS
  • A minimum of 1-3 years of professional experience, preferably in the consulting industry, or technical program equivalent
  • Demonstrated abilities in the use of ESRI GIS software (ArcMap, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online)
  • Report writing, organization, and interpersonal skills
  • Versatile, adaptable, and willing to conduct a variety of tasks


Experience
  • Proficient in data compilation, relational database design, and extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes
  • Designing custom data collection tools and models with automated reports
  • Using statistics and machine learning principles to manipulate data and present results from large datasets
  • Understanding of spatial analysis, spatial statistics, remote sensing, and working knowledge of ESRI analysis tools (Network Analyst, Spatial Analyst, 3D Analyst)
  • Development of mobile applications (Survey123, Collector, Field Maps) and ArcGIS Online web applications
  • Demonstrated abilities in multidisciplinary project teamwork and coordination
  • Proficient in the writing of technical reports
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication, and organizational skills
  • Working knowledge of the following programs and programming languages would be considered an asset: AutoCAD, Pix4D, Power BI, CityEngine, Python, ArcPy, JavaScript, and Arcade


Young professionals with less than three years of consulting experience have an opportunity to join Dillon Early Career Development (ECD) . Our ECD program is a unique component of our overall Talent Pipeline, designed to accelerate the development of our early career professionals as consultants. Program participants are offered enhanced opportunities for learning and development while building a sense of community through both formal and informal learning.

Dillon’s commitment to the growth and development of our people is a driving force of our success. With over a third of our staff participating in this program, our young professionals are provided with a unique opportunity to practice self-development and build for Dillon’s future.

Compensation

$52,400-$78,800

At Dillon, we believe in transparency. The following salary range is what we expect to offer for this position. It will be dependent on the successful applicant’s education, experience, and skills, in addition to internal equity and geographic region. Dillon reserves the right to pay outside of the posted range, contingent on factors unrelated to an applicant’s gender or other status protected by provincial and/or federal law.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Dillon offers:
  • Flexible work hours and hybrid work arrangement options to help balance the competing demands of work and personal life
  • Employee share purchase plan
    • Dillon is 100% employee-owned, and share ownership is open to all employees. Our annual share dividends have historically outperformed the market average.
  • Dillon’s Overtime Directive
    • This Management Directive establishes a firm-wide 40-hour weekly overtime threshold, after which premium pay applies, ensuring consistent and fair compensation across all Canadian offices.
  • Competitive benefits package, including:
    • Comprehensive health benefits
    • Generous retirement savings plan with employer matching up to 5.5%
    • Student loan repayment assistance
    • Wellness allowance and enhanced mental health benefits
    • Ample paid vacation
    • Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP)
    • Goodlife Fitness Corporate Membership rates
  • Early Career Development (ECD) program
    • At Dillon, we build careers. Designed for technical professionals with less than three years of consulting experience, the ECD program accelerates the transition into entrepreneurial consultants through monthly ‘Level Up’ sessions that build both technical and consulting capabilities. Own your success; we provide the blueprint.

Health & Safety at Dillon
Prospective employees are expected to fully align with Dillon's core commitment to Health & Safety. This includes active, ongoing engagement with our Health & Safety processes and platform, and the active, ongoing identification and reporting of health and safety hazards.

Employment Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Dillon
Dillon is committed to employment equity and an inclusive, diverse workplace where opportunities are based on skills and abilities. If you require accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

Technology enablement and the use of AI at Dillon
Please be advised that Dillon uses AI-assisted tools to support aspects of our recruitment process to increase efficiency and fairness. While AI supports the process, all hiring decisions are made by our human recruiting team. By applying, you acknowledge and consent to this use.

Description:
Interested in a career at Langara College?

Our employees exemplify Langara's values of excellence, collegiality, innovation and integrity. If you think this position fits your qualifications, we encourage you to apply!

Langara College is located in Vancouver, B.C.: applicants to postings must be located in BC or willing to move to BC to accept work with Langara College. Exceptions to this will be clearly outlined in the event Langara College requires work (or positions to be based) to be performed outside BC or Canada.

Current employee? Apply through Careers in your Workday account.

Job Title

Strategic Analytics Coordinator

Employee Group

Administrator

Employee Type

Temporary (Fixed Term)

Start Date

Monday, October 19 2026

End Date (if Applicable)

Tuesday, June 22 2027

Job Summary

We are seeking a Strategic Analytics Coordinator to support the ongoing sustainment and optimization of Langara College’s Workday Student platform and related ERP systems. This hands-on role will work with business and technical teams to analyze requirements and issues, document solutions, support testing and releases, and provide production support. The successful candidate will have experience with Workday Student or a comparable ERP/SIS environment, with knowledge of one or more student-related functional areas such as Admissions, Records, Registration, Curriculum, or Advising. Experience with requirements analysis, data analysis, testing, documentation, or application support is preferred. Exposure to Workday configuration, business processes, security, integrations, Agile/Scrum, or CRM platforms is an asset.

Job Description

Duties & Responsibilities


Works in partnership with Strategic Analytic Consultants (SAC)’s to analyze current processes, future requirements and the gaps that exist between current information system capabilities and future requirements.
Supports a range of projects that involve objective and comprehensive business analytics, data analysis, research, business process reviews/re-engineering and management reporting and for providing recommendations.
Supports SAC’s in enhancing and optimizing Workday configurations in improving processes and enabling them through use of the Workday platform and automation.
Documents business processes, business scenarios, detailed business requirements.
Develops testing strategies, including writing and coordination of test script execution within Workday.
Supports business process development, setup modifications, integrations, security, and overall maintenance of Workday.
Creates and maintains simple system configuration and troubleshooting of business processes.
Assist with bi-annual releases, including analysis of impacts of new functionality, testing, integrations and cross-functional up and downstream analysis.
Prepares in depth business and analytical reports.
Synthesizes and consolidates complex information into succinct and meaningful written and verbal management reporting, leveraging productivity tools such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Works cross-functionally to develop management productivity tools such as dashboards, apps, reports etc. in order to improve operational performance.
Triages, assesses, prioritizes, and resolves Workday end-user tickets and provides Tier 1 ITSM coverage on as needed basis.
Actively promotes best practices in the security and privacy of personal information and data; makes recommendations to improve processes and procedures where necessary.
Solicits feedback from manager and SAC’s and respective stakeholders, fostering an agile, innovative, and collaborative environment. Partners with relevant stakeholders to resolve issues related to engagement, adoption, sustainment, and continuous improvement.
Analyzes, troubleshoots, and diagnoses root causes and applies appropriate solutions to restore end-user issues.
Develops Tier 0/1 content materials to enhance knowledge base and keep information accurate and current; prepares and maintains service centre documentation is accordance with prescribed standards.
Performs other related duties as assigned.


Qualifications Required

Education & Experience


Degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or related discipline.
Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a similar role includes system support, analysis, and ERP implementation.
An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
Superior analytical, problem-solving and system analysis skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office suite with intermediate knowledge of Excel.
Experience working in customer service environments.
Experience with an ITSM and JIRA system is an asset.
Experience working with integrated corporate HRIS such as Workday or similar cloud-based ERP preferred.


Skills & Abilities


Strong attention to detail.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills. Strong analytical mind; demonstrated critical thinking and analytic skills with strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Excellent collaborator and a team player.
Well-developed root-cause analytical skills with the ability to configure and troubleshoot issues and defects.
Ability to communicate with stakeholders of varying technical ability and subject matter expertise.
Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess the clients’ needs and situation.
Ability to prioritize workload and provide timely follow-up and resolution.
Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and priorities while working under pressure to meet critical, time sensitive deadlines.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.


Additional Info

Why Join Langara?

At Langara College, we support the College’s vision of promoting wellness and fostering personal and professional growth for our employees. We are dedicated to embracing, honouring, and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion, while offering a competitive and inclusive benefits package that reflects our commitment to overall health, financial security, and work-life balance.


Eligibility and entitlements may vary based on the employment group, and if the position is temporary, part-time, or casual **


We Offer The Following Benefits


Extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Hybrid-work program for eligible positions
Generous vacation package plus paid time off during college winter closure (1 week in December)
Employer paid defined benefit pension plan
Potential eligibility for educational, training, and developmental programs
Access to on-site daycare subject to availability
Tuition waivers for courses at Langara College, subject to space availability
Course/program tuition reimbursements
Wellness classes and campus engagement events


Salary Range

$38.86 - $56.99 per hour

Pay Grade

Admin Paygrade 07

Compensation beyond the mid-point requires approval by the Public Sector Employers’ Council Secretariat (PSEC).

Scheduled Weekly Hours

35

Hours may vary according to the needs of the department.

Closing Date

Friday, October 16 2026

People and Culture is committed to embracing, honoring, and promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion in our workplace. We remain dedicated to focusing our efforts on creating an inclusive employee community that fosters a sense of safety and belonging for everyone. We humbly acknowledge that we are just beginning our journey, which includes engaging in our own internal learning and creating a data-driven action plan that supports the integration of EDI practice into the work of People and Culture and the work we do with employees and leaders. Langara College welcomes applications from everyone including people from groups that are experiencing inequity including, but not limited to, Indigenous people, racialized people, people with disabilities, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community. If there are any barriers that you are experiencing or an accommodation that we can provide to support you through the application process, please contact us.

Shortlisted candidates will be required to provide proof of educational and professional credentials noted on their resume. In addition, those shortlisted with international credentials must have their education credentials evaluated through WES (World Education Services) and provide Langara College, People & Culture document evaluation access for employment purposes.

We thank you for your interest in Langara College and for taking the time to complete an application. Only complete applications will be reviewed. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to the number of applications received.

Langara is committed to enhancing our diverse workforce.
